import json, base64, zlib, io, pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr

def load_panel(fid):
    d = json.load(open(f'factors/{fid}.json'))
    sa = d['validation']['signal_artifact']
    if sa.get('format') == 'base64:zlib:csv':
        raw = base64.b64decode(sa['data']); csv_bytes = zlib.decompress(raw)
        df = pd.read_csv(io.BytesIO(csv_bytes))
        p = df.pivot(index='date', columns='symbol', values='value') if 'symbol' in df.columns else df.set_index(df.columns[0])
        p.columns = [str(c) for c in p.columns]; p.index = pd.to_datetime(p.index)
    else:
        dates = pd.to_datetime(sa['dates']); assets = sa['assets']
        p = pd.DataFrame({a: pd.Series(sa['values'][a], index=dates, dtype=float) for a in assets})
    return p.sort_index()

fids = ['vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60','dn_mkt_beta_60d','rate_beta_cn10y_60d']
panels = {f: load_panel(f) for f in fids}
live = ['SPX','NDX','SOX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y','000300.SH']
live = [c for c in live if c in panels[fids[0]].columns]

# recent dense window 2027-01-01 .. 2028-03-10
win = (pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01'), pd.Timestamp('2028-03-10'))
for i in range(3):
    for j in range(i+1,3):
        A, B = panels[fids[i]], panels[fids[j]]
        cd = A.index.intersection(B.index)
        cd = cd[(cd>=win[0]) & (cd<=win[1])]
        vals = []
        for t in cd:
            a = A.loc[t, live]; b = B.loc[t, live]
            m = a.notna() & b.notna()
            if m.sum() < 6: continue
            vals.append(spearmanr(a[m], b[m]).statistic)
        print(f'pairwise rank-corr {fids[i]} vs {fids[j]} (2027-01..2028-03): n={len(vals)} mean={np.mean(vals):.3f} | last30 mean={np.mean(vals[-30:]):.3f}')

# quality q and pure-tilt weights
q = {'vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60': 0.1228*0.4955, 'dn_mkt_beta_60d': 0.0554*0.1404, 'rate_beta_cn10y_60d': 0.052*0.1543}
tot = sum(q.values())
print('\nq:', {k: round(v,5) for k,v in q.items()})
print('pure quality tilt weights:', {k: round(v/tot,4) for k,v in q.items()})
EOF

python << 'EOF'
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
cutoff = '2028-03-24'
assets = ['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
px = {}
for a in assets:
    df = pd.read_csv(f'../persistent/stock_data/{a}.csv')
    df.columns = [c.strip() for c in df.columns]
    dcol = 'date' if 'date' in df.columns else df.columns[0]
    df[dcol] = pd.to_datetime(df[dcol])
    df = df[df[dcol] <= cutoff].sort_values(dcol)
    px[a] = df.set_index(dcol)['close']
px = pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index()
ret = px.pct_change()
mkt = ret.mean(axis=1)

def ic_series(sig, fwd_ret, min_valid=8):
    out = {}
    for t in sig.index:
        s = sig.loc[t]; f = fwd_ret.loc[t]
        mask = s.notna() & f.notna()
        if mask.sum() < min_valid: continue
        out[t] = np.corrcoef(s[mask].rank(), f[mask].rank())[0,1]
    return pd.Series(out)

# factor 1: vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60
r20 = px.pct_change(20); r60 = px.pct_change(60); v20 = ret.rolling(20).std()
sig_accel = (r20 - r60) / v20

# factor 2: dn_mkt_beta_60d (beta on down-market days)
down = mkt[mkt < 0]
def dn_beta(asset_ret, mkt_ret, win=60, min_obs=40):
    a = asset_ret.rename('a'); m = mkt_ret.rename('m')
    df = pd.concat([a,m], axis=1).dropna()
    out = pd.Series(np.nan, index=asset_ret.index)
    for t in asset_ret.index:
        w = df.loc[:t].tail(win)
        w = w[w['m'] < 0]
        if len(w) < min_obs: continue
        out[t] = np.polyfit(w['m'], w['a'], 1)[0]
    return out
# vectorized approx: rolling cov/var on down days
sig_dn = pd.DataFrame(index=ret.index, columns=assets, dtype=float)
for a in assets:
    dd = pd.DataFrame({'a': ret[a], 'm': mkt}).dropna()
    dd = dd[dd['m'] < 0]
    cov = dd['a'].rolling(60).cov(dd['m'])
    var = dd['m'].rolling(60).var()
    sig_dn[a] = cov/var

# factor 3: rate_beta_cn10y_60d
cn10y = px['CN10Y'].pct_change()
sig_rb = pd.DataFrame(index=ret.index, columns=assets, dtype=float)
for a in assets:
    dd = pd.DataFrame({'a': ret[a], 'r': cn10y}).dropna()
    cov = dd['a'].rolling(60).cov(dd['r'])
    var = dd['r'].rolling(60).var()
    sig_rb[a] = cov/var

fwd = ret.shift(-10)
for name, sig, sign in [('vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60', sig_accel, 1),
                        ('dn_mkt_beta_60d', sig_dn, 1),
                        ('rate_beta_cn10y_60d', sig_rb, -1)]:
    ic = ic_series(sig, fwd)
    ic_recent = ic[ic.index >= '2027-10-01']
    ic_60 = ic[ic.index >= '2028-01-01']
    print(f'{name} (dir {sign}): full IC {ic.mean():+.4f} | since 2027-10: {ic_recent.mean():+.4f} (n={len(ic_recent)}) | since 2028-01: {ic_60.mean():+.4f} (n={len(ic_60)})')
EOF

    px[a] = df

# VIX / DXY (observation only)
for m in ['VIX','DXY']:
    df = pd.read_csv(f'../persistent/index_data/{m}.csv')
    df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
    df = df[df['date'] <= VIS].set_index('date')
    col = 'close' if 'close' in df.columns else df.columns[0]
    s = df[col].astype(float).dropna()
    print(f'{m}: last={s.iloc[-1]:.2f} 10d_ago={s.iloc[-6]:.2f} 20d_ago={s.iloc[-21]:.2f} 60d_ago={s.iloc[-61]:.2f}' if len(s)>=61 else f'{m}: last={s.iloc[-1]:.2f} n={len(s)}')

# equal-weight trend (live assets only, exclude frozen)
live = [a for a in assets if a not in ('000300.SH','HSI','ETH')]
ew = pxdf[live].mean(axis=1).dropna()
ewr = ew.pct_change()
ma20 = ew.rolling(20).mean(); ma60 = ew.rolling(60).mean()

# consecutive up/down days on EW
signs = np.sign(ewr.dropna().iloc[-30:])
run = 1
for i in range(len(signs)-1, 0, -1):
    if signs.iloc[i] == signs.iloc[i-1]: run += 1
    else: break
print(f'EW consecutive same-direction days (last 30): {run} ({signs.iloc[-1]:+.0f})')

# realized vol SPX and EW

print(f'\nSPX realized vol: 20d={vol20:.1f}% 60d={vol60:.1f}%')
# max drawdown 60d

print('10d losers:', r10.sort_values().head(4).round(4).to_dict())

pxdf = pd.DataFrame(px).dropna(how='all')
rets = pxdf.pct_change()

for m in ['VIX','DXY']:
    df = pd.read_csv(f'../persistent/index_data/{m}.csv')
    df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
    df = df[df['date'] <= VIS].set_index('date')
    col = 'close' if 'close' in df.columns else df.columns[0]
    s = df[col].astype(float).dropna()
    if len(s)>=61:
        print(f'{m}: last={s.iloc[-1]:.2f} 10d_ago={s.iloc[-6]:.2f} 20d_ago={s.iloc[-21]:.2f} 60d_ago={s.iloc[-61]:.2f}')
    else:
        print(f'{m}: last={s.iloc[-1]:.2f} n={len(s)}')

live = [a for a in assets if a not in ('000300.SH','HSI','ETH')]
ew = pxdf[live].mean(axis=1).dropna()
ewr = ew.pct_change()
ma20 = ew.rolling(20).mean(); ma60 = ew.rolling(60).mean()
print(f'\nEW-live: last={ew.iloc[-1]:.2f} MA20={ma20.iloc[-1]:.2f} MA60={ma60.iloc[-1]:.2f} MA20/MA60={ma20.iloc[-1]/ma60.iloc[-1]:.3f}')

signs = np.sign(ewr.dropna().iloc[-30:])
run = 1
for i in range(len(signs)-1, 0, -1):
    if signs.iloc[i] == signs.iloc[i-1]: run += 1
    else: break
print(f'EW consecutive same-direction days (last 30): {run} ({signs.iloc[-1]:+.0f})')

spx = pxdf['SPX'].dropna(); spr = spx.pct_change()
vol20 = spr.tail(20).std()*np.sqrt(252)*100
vol60 = spr.tail(60).std()*np.sqrt(252)*100
print(f'\nSPX realized vol: 20d={vol20:.1f}% 60d={vol60:.1f}%')
dd = (spx.tail(60)/spx.tail(60).cummax()-1).min()*100
print(f'SPX 60d max drawdown: {dd:.2f}%')

print('10d losers:', r10.sort_values().head(4).round(4).to_dict())

rc = rets[live].tail(40)
corr = rc.corr().copy()

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, json

with open('../persistent/date.json') as f:
    dj = json.load(f)
tdays = set(dj['trading_days'])
vis = dj['visible_through']

assets = ['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
closes = {}
for a in assets:
    df = pd.read_csv(f'../persistent/stock_data/{a}.csv')
    df['date'] = df['date'].astype(str)
    df = df[df['date'].isin(tdays) & (df['date'] <= vis)]
    df = df.sort_values('date').drop_duplicates('date')
    closes[a] = df.set_index('date')['close']
px = pd.DataFrame(closes).sort_index()
rets = px.pct_change()

# equal-weight market index
mkt = px.mean(axis=1)
mkt_ret = mkt.pct_change()
print('=== equal-weight market (15 assets, incl frozen) ===')
print('last close', round(mkt.iloc[-1],2))
print('r20', round((mkt.iloc[-1]/mkt.iloc[-21]-1)*100,2),'%')
print('r60', round((mkt.iloc[-1]/mkt.iloc[-61]-1)*100,2),'%')
print('r120', round((mkt.iloc[-1]/mkt.iloc[-121]-1)*100,2),'%')

# MA regime: price vs MA60, MA20 vs MA60 slope
ma20 = mkt.rolling(20).mean()
ma60 = mkt.rolling(60).mean()
print('px vs MA20:', round((mkt.iloc[-1]/ma20.iloc[-1]-1)*100,2),'%')
print('px vs MA60:', round((mkt.iloc[-1]/ma60.iloc[-1]-1)*100,2),'%')
print('MA20 vs MA60:', round((ma20.iloc[-1]/ma60.iloc[-1]-1)*100,2),'%')

# realized vol of market (20d annualized)
vol20 = mkt_ret.tail(20).std()*np.sqrt(252)*100
vol60 = mkt_ret.tail(60).std()*np.sqrt(252)*100
print('mkt realized vol 20d ann: %.2f%%  60d ann: %.2f%%' % (vol20, vol60))

# cross-sectional dispersion of 20d returns
disp = rets.tail(20).mean(axis=1)  # not this; compute cross-sectional std of cumulative returns
cum20 = (1+rets.tail(20)).prod()-1
csd = cum20.std()
print('cross-sectional dispersion of 20d returns (std):', round(csd*100,2),'%')
print('cross-sectional 20d return range:', round(cum20.min()*100,2),'to',round(cum20.max()*100,2),'%')

# average pairwise correlation of daily returns (last 60d)
c = rets.tail(60).corr()
mask = np.triu(np.ones(c.shape), k=1).astype(bool)
avg_corr = c.values[mask]
print('avg pairwise corr 60d:', round(np.nanmean(avg_corr),3))

# VIX
vix = pd.read_csv('../persistent/index_data/VIX.csv')
vix['date']=vix['date'].astype(str)
vix = vix[vix['date'].isin(tdays) & (vix['date']<=vis)].sort_values('date')
print('=== VIX ===')
print('last', vix.iloc[-1]['date'], 'close', round(vix.iloc[-1]['close'],2), '| 20d ago', round(vix.iloc[-21]['close'],2) if len(vix)>21 else 'na')
"

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, glob

files = sorted(glob.glob('../persistent/stock_data/*.csv'))
names = [os.path.basename(f).replace('.csv','') for f in files]

closes = {}
for f,n in zip(files,names):
    df = pd.read_csv(f, parse_dates=['date'])
    df = df[df['date'] <= '2028-05-19'].set_index('date')['close']
    closes[n] = df

px = pd.DataFrame(closes).sort_index()
print("date range:", px.index.min(), "->", px.index.max(), "rows:", len(px))
ret = px.pct_change().dropna(how='all')

# equal-weight market
mkt = ret.mean(axis=1)
mkt_px = (1+mkt).cumprod()

def ann_vol(s, win=20):
    return s.rolling(win).std().iloc[-1]*np.sqrt(252)

print("\n=== MARKET (equal-weight 15) ===")
for h in [5,10,20,60,120]:
    if len(mkt)>=h:
        print(f"mkt {h}d return: {mkt.iloc[-h:].sum()*100:+.2f}%")
print(f"mkt 20d ann vol: {ann_vol(mkt):.2%}")
print(f"mkt 60d ann vol: {ann_vol(mkt,60):.2%}")
print(f"mkt 20d vol / 60d vol: {ann_vol(mkt)/ann_vol(mkt,60):.2f}")
# MA trend
ma20 = mkt_px.rolling(20).mean().iloc[-1]; ma60 = mkt_px.rolling(60).mean().iloc[-1]
last = mkt_px.iloc[-1]
print(f"mkt px {last:.3f}, MA20 {ma20:.3f}, MA60 {ma60:.3f}, px>MA20: {last>ma20}, px>MA60: {last>ma60}")
print(f"MA20 slope (10d chg): {(ma20/mkt_px.rolling(20).mean().iloc[-11]-1)*100:+.2f}%")

# recent block 2028-05-08..05-19
block = px[px.index >= '2028-05-08']
print("\n=== BLOCK 2028-05-08..2028-05-19 per asset ===")
blk_ret = (block.iloc[-1]/block.iloc[0]-1)
for n in names:
    print(f"{n:12s} {blk_ret[n]*100:+7.2f}%")
print(f"block equal-w avg: {blk_ret.mean()*100:+.2f}%")

# 60d and 120d momentum per asset
print("\n=== MOMENTUM (ret through 2028-05-19) ===")
for h in [20,60,120]:
    r = (px.iloc[-1]/px.iloc[-1-h]-1) if len(px)>h else np.nan
    s = r.sort_values()
    print(f"{h}d:", " ".join(f"{k}{v*100:+.0f}%" for k,v in s.items()))

# volatility per asset (20d)
vols = ret.rolling(20).std().iloc[-1]*np.sqrt(252)
print("\n=== 20d ann vol per asset ===")
print(vols.sort_values().round(3).to_string())

# dispersion / correlation: mean pairwise corr of last 60d daily rets
c = ret.tail(60).corr()
mask = np.triu(np.ones(c.shape), k=1).astype(bool)
print(f"\nmean pairwise corr (60d): {c.values[mask].mean():.3f}")
c20 = ret.tail(20).corr()
print(f"mean pairwise corr (20d): {c20.values[np.triu(np.ones(c20.shape),k=1).astype(bool)].mean():.3f}")
EOF

"""Screener cycle 2028-06-05: regime assessment + recent live IC for active factors.
Data visible window: <= 2028-06-04 (last completed trading day before decision date).
No backtest/step usage; pure factor analytics on the 15-asset cross-section.
"""
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, glob, os, json

CUT = '2028-06-04'

# ---- load 15 tradable assets ----
files = sorted(glob.glob('../persistent/stock_data/*.csv'))
px = {}
for f in files:
    sym = os.path.basename(f).replace('.csv', '')
    df = pd.read_csv(f)
    df.columns = [c.strip().lower() for c in df.columns]
    df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
    df = df.set_index('date').sort_index()
    px[sym] = df['close'].astype(float)
px = pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index()
px = px[px.index <= CUT]

print('visible data range:', px.index.min().date(), '->', px.index.max().date(), '| rows', len(px))

# ---- macro observation signals ----
def load_idx(sym):
    df = pd.read_csv(f'../persistent/index_data/{sym}.csv')
    df.columns = [c.strip().lower() for c in df.columns]
    df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
    return df.set_index('date').sort_index()['close'].astype(float)

macro = {s: load_idx(s) for s in ['DXY', 'VIX', 'EURUSD', 'USDJPY', 'USDCNY']}
for s in macro:
    macro[s] = macro[s][macro[s].index <= CUT]

# ---- regime stats ----
rets = px.pct_change()
mkt = rets.mean(axis=1)  # equal-weight 15-asset market

# trend: 20d / 60d / 120d cumulative market return
for w in [20, 60, 120]:
    r = (1 + mkt).rolling(w).apply(np.prod, raw=True) - 1
    print(f'mkt {w:3d}d cum return: {r.iloc[-1]*100:+.2f}%')

# realized vol (ann) of equal-weight market, 20d and 60d
for w in [20, 60]:
    v = mkt.rolling(w).std() * np.sqrt(252)
    print(f'mkt {w:3d}d realized vol (ann): {v.iloc[-1]*100:.1f}%')

# cross-sectional dispersion: std of 20d asset returns
disp = rets.rolling(20).apply(lambda x: np.nanstd(x.mean(axis=0) if False else x, axis=0), raw=True)
cs_ret20 = (1 + rets).rolling(20).apply(np.prod, raw=True) - 1
cs_disp = cs_ret20.std(axis=1)
print(f'cross-sectional dispersion of 20d asset returns: last={cs_disp.iloc[-1]*100:.2f}%  '
      f'3m mean={cs_disp.iloc[-65:].mean()*100:.2f}%  1y mean={cs_disp.iloc[-252:].mean()*100:.2f}%')

# average pairwise correlation of daily returns (60d window)
corr60 = rets.rolling(60).corr()
avg_corr = {}
for d in corr60.index.unique()[-1:]:
    c = corr60.loc[d]
    vals = c.values[np.triu_indices_from(c.values, k=1)]
    avg_corr[d] = np.nanmean(vals)
print('avg pairwise corr (60d, latest):', {str(k.date()): round(v, 3) for k, v in avg_corr.items()})

# VIX / DXY levels
for s in ['VIX', 'DXY', 'USDJPY', 'EURUSD', 'USDCNY']:
    x = macro[s]
    print(f'{s}: last={x.iloc[-1]:.2f}  60d ago={x.iloc[-61] if len(x)>61 else np.nan:.2f}')

# block returns for the 15 assets over recent 10d blocks (for context)
print('\n=== recent 10d block returns by asset ===')
for label, a, b in [('05-08..05-22', '2028-05-08', '2028-05-22'),
                    ('05-22..06-04', '2028-05-22', '2028-06-04')]:
    pa = px.loc[:a].iloc[-1]
    pb = px.loc[:b].iloc[-1]
    r = pb / pa - 1
    print(label, r.sort_values().round(4).to_dict())

# ---- factor computation ----
def rolling_beta(y, x, win=60, min_obs=40):
    out = pd.Series(index=y.index, dtype=float)
    for i in range(len(y)):
        if i < win:
            continue
        ys, xs = y.iloc[i-win:i], x.iloc[i-win:i]
        m = ys.notna() & xs.notna()
        if m.sum() < min_obs:
            continue
        out.iloc[i] = np.polyfit(xs[m], ys[m], 1)[0]
    return out

dnmkt = mkt.where(mkt < 0, 0.0)
f_dn = pd.DataFrame(index=px.index, columns=px.columns, dtype=float)
f_cn = pd.DataFrame(index=px.index, columns=px.columns, dtype=float)
f_mom = pd.DataFrame(index=px.index, columns=px.columns, dtype=float)
for c in px.columns:
    f_dn[c] = rolling_beta(rets[c], dnmkt, 60, 40)
    f_cn[c] = rolling_beta(rets[c], px['CN10Y'].pct_change(), 60, 40)
    r20 = px[c] / px[c].shift(20) - 1
    r60 = px[c] / px[c].shift(60) - 1
    v20 = rets[c].rolling(20).std()
    f_mom[c] = (r20 - r60) / v20

facs = {'vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60': f_mom, 'dn_mkt_beta_60d': f_dn, 'rate_beta_cn10y_60d': f_cn}

fwd = px.shift(-10) / px - 1

def rank_ic(fval, fwd10, start, end, min_valid=6):
    fv = fval.loc[start:end]
    fr = fwd10.loc[start:end]
    ics = []
    for d in fv.index:
        x = fv.loc[d]
        y = fr.loc[d]
        m = x.notna() & y.notna()
        if m.sum() < min_valid:
            continue
        ics.append((d, x[m].rank().corr(y[m].rank())))
    if not ics:
        return None
    return pd.Series(dict(ics))

print('\n=== recent rank IC (h=10) by window ===')
windows = [('2028 YTD', '2028-01-01', '2028-06-04'),
           ('last 6m', '2027-12-01', '2028-06-04'),
           ('last 3m', '2028-03-01', '2028-06-04'),
           ('last 60td', None, None),
           ('last 40td', None, None)]
for label, a, b in windows:
    if a is None:
        a = px.index[-61]
        b = px.index[-1]
    print(f'--- {label} ({a.date()}..{b.date()}) ---')
    for name, fv in facs.items():
        s = rank_ic(fv, fwd, a, b)
        if s is None or len(s) == 0:
            print(f'  {name}: no data')
            continue
        ic = s.mean()
        icir = s.mean() / s.std() if s.std() > 0 else np.nan
        hit = (np.sign(s) > 0).mean()
        print(f'  {name}: n={len(s):3d} IC={ic:+.4f} ICIR={icir:+.3f} hit={hit:.2f}')

# ---- last factor cross-section (for intuition) ----
print('\n=== latest factor exposures (2028-06-04) ===')
last = px.index[-1]
for name, fv in facs.items():
    x = fv.loc[last].dropna().sort_values()
    print(f'{name}:')
    print('   low :', x.head(5).round(3).to_dict())
    print('   high:', x.tail(5).round(3).to_dict())

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, glob, os

assets = ['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
data = {}
for a in assets:
    p = f'../persistent/stock_data/{a}.csv'
    df = pd.read_csv(p)
    df.columns = [c.strip() for c in df.columns]
    df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
    df = df.sort_values('date').set_index('date')
    data[a] = df['close']

px = pd.DataFrame(data)
px = px[px.index <= '2028-06-30']
px = px.dropna(how='all')
print("rows:", len(px), "last date:", px.index[-1].date())

# recent returns
for label, d in [('5d',5),('10d',10),('20d',20),('60d',60)]:
    ret = px.iloc[-1]/px.iloc[-1-d] - 1
    print(f"\n== {label} return ==")
    print((ret*100).round(2).sort_values(ascending=False).to_string())

# volatility (20d annualized approx) and 60d
r = px.pct_change()
vol20 = r.tail(20).std()*np.sqrt(252)
vol60 = r.tail(60).std()*np.sqrt(252)
print("\n== 20d ann vol % ==")
print((vol20*100).round(1).sort_values(ascending=False).to_string())
print("\n== 60d ann vol % ==")
print((vol60*100).round(1).sort_values(ascending=False).to_string())

# trend: close vs 20d MA and 60d MA
ma20 = px.rolling(20).mean().iloc[-1]
ma60 = px.rolling(60).mean().iloc[-1]
last = px.iloc[-1]
print("\n== trend (last/ma20-1, last/ma60-1) % ==")
t = pd.DataFrame({'vs20': (last/ma20-1)*100, 'vs60': (last/ma60-1)*100})
print(t.round(2).to_string())

# equal-weight market trend & cumulative
ew = px.mean(axis=1)

python << 'EOF'
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, os

# Load all 15 tradable + 5 macro CSVs
data = {}
for sym in ['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']:
    path = f'../persistent/stock_data/{sym}.csv'
    df = pd.read_csv(path)
    df.columns = [c.strip().lower() for c in df.columns]
    if 'date' in df.columns:
        df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
        df = df.set_index('date').sort_index()
    data[sym] = df

for sym in ['DXY','USDCNY','USDJPY','EURUSD','VIX']:
    path = f'../persistent/index_data/{sym}.csv'
    df = pd.read_csv(path)
    df.columns = [c.strip().lower() for c in df.columns]
    if 'date' in df.columns:
        df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
        df = df.set_index('date').sort_index()
    data[sym] = df

print("=== Data ranges ===")
for k in ['SPX','XAU','BTC','US10Y','CN10Y','VIX','DXY']:
    print(k, data[k].index.min().date(), '->', data[k].index.max().date(), 'cols:', list(data[k].columns))

# Compute recent stats up to visible_through 2028-07-28
cutoff = pd.Timestamp('2028-07-28')
print("\n=== Recent price moves (through", cutoff.date(), ") ===")
for sym in ['SPX','NDX','SOX','000300.SH','000688.SH','HSI','N225','SX5E','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']:
    df = data[sym]
    d = df[df.index <= cutoff]
    if len(d) < 30: 
        print(sym, 'insufficient'); continue
    px_col = 'close' if 'close' in d.columns else d.columns[0]
    px = d[px_col].astype(float)
    r = px.pct_change().dropna()
    ret5 = px.iloc[-1]/px.iloc[-6]-1 if len(px)>6 else np.nan
    ret20 = px.iloc[-1]/px.iloc[-21]-1 if len(px)>21 else np.nan
    ret60 = px.iloc[-1]/px.iloc[-61]-1 if len(px)>61 else np.nan
    vol20 = r.iloc[-20:].std()*np.sqrt(252)
    ma20 = px.iloc[-20:].mean()
    trend = 'UP' if px.iloc[-1]>ma20 else 'DOWN'
    print(f"{sym:12s} ret5d={ret5*100:7.2f}% ret20d={ret20*100:7.2f}% ret60d={ret60*100:7.2f}% vol20={vol20*100:5.1f}% px={px.iloc[-1]:.2f} vsMA20={trend}")

print("\n=== Macro signals (through", cutoff.date(), ") ===")
for sym in ['DXY','USDCNY','USDJPY','EURUSD','VIX']:
    df = data[sym]
    d = df[df.index <= cutoff]
    if len(d) < 20: continue
    px_col = 'close' if 'close' in d.columns else d.columns[0]
    px = d[px_col].astype(float)
    ret20 = px.iloc[-1]/px.iloc[-21]-1 if len(px)>21 else np.nan
    print(f"{sym:8s} last={px.iloc[-1]:.2f} ret20d={ret20*100:6.2f}%")
EOF

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, glob, os

    df = pd.read_csv(f)

    datecol = 'date' if 'date' in df.columns else df.columns[0]
    df[datecol] = pd.to_datetime(df[datecol])
    df = df.set_index(datecol).sort_index()
    closecol = 'close' if 'close' in df.columns else ('Close' if 'Close' in df.columns else df.columns[1])

# last close date per asset

    valid = px[c].dropna()
    print(f"{c:10s} last={valid.index[-1].date()} n_valid={len(valid)}")

# recent returns

recent = px.iloc[-1]

    s = px[c].dropna()
    if len(s) < 25: continue
    r10 = s.iloc[-1]/s.iloc[-11]-1 if len(s)>11 else np.nan

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, glob, os
files = sorted(glob.glob('../persistent/stock_data/*.csv'))
print('n files:', len(files))
dfs={}
for f in files:
    sym=os.path.basename(f).replace('.csv','')
    d=pd.read_csv(f)
    d.columns=[c.strip() for c in d.columns]
    datecol=[c for c in d.columns if 'date' in c.lower()][0]
    d[datecol]=pd.to_datetime(d[datecol])
    d=d.sort_values(datecol).set_index(datecol)
    dfs[sym]=d
# align closes
closes=pd.DataFrame({s:dfs[s]['close'] for s in dfs})
closes=closes.dropna(how='all')
ret=closes.pct_change()
print('visible through:', closes.index[-1].date(), '| last row non-null counts:')
print(closes.iloc[-1].notna().sum())
last=closes.index[-1]
for look in [20,60,120]:
    r=(closes.iloc[-1]/closes.iloc[-1-look]-1)*100 if len(closes)>look else np.nan
    print(f'{look}d ret %:')
    print(r.round(2).to_string())
# realized vol (annualized, 20d)
vol20=ret.tail(20).std()*np.sqrt(252)*100
print('20d realized vol ann %:'); print(vol20.round(1).to_string())
# trend: close vs 60d MA
ma60=closes.rolling(60).mean()
above=(closes.iloc[-1]>ma60.iloc[-1])
print('above 60d MA:'); print(above.to_string())
"

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, glob, os
files = sorted(glob.glob('../persistent/stock_data/*.csv'))
dfs={}
for f in files:
    sym=os.path.basename(f).replace('.csv','')
    d=pd.read_csv(f); d.columns=[c.strip() for c in d.columns]
    dc=[c for c in d.columns if 'date' in c.lower()][0]
    d[dc]=pd.to_datetime(d[dc]); d=d.sort_values(dc).set_index(dc)
    dfs[sym]=d
cut=pd.Timestamp('2028-09-08')
closes=pd.DataFrame({s:dfs[s]['close'] for s in dfs})
closes=closes[closes.index<=cut]
closes=closes.dropna(how='all')
print('rows:',len(closes),'last:',closes.index[-1].date())
print('last non-null date per asset:')
print(closes.apply(lambda c: c.last_valid_index().date() if c.last_valid_index() else None).to_string())
ret=closes.pct_change()
print()
for look in [20,60,120]:
    r=(closes.iloc[-1]/closes.iloc[-1-look]-1)*100 if len(closes)>look else np.nan
    print(f'{look}d ret %:'); print(r.round(2).to_string())
vol20=ret.tail(20).std()*np.sqrt(252)*100
print(); print('20d realized vol ann %:'); print(vol20.round(1).to_string())
ma60=closes.rolling(60).mean()
print(); print('above 60d MA:'); print((closes.iloc[-1]>ma60.iloc[-1]).to_string())
# equal-weight cross-asset momentum & trend
ew=closes.mean(axis=1)
print(); print('EW index last 5 closes:'); print(ew.tail(5).round(2).to_string())
print('EW 20d/60d ret %:', round((ew.iloc[-1]/ew.iloc[-21]-1)*100,2), round((ew.iloc[-1]/ew.iloc[-61]-1)*100,2))
"

ew_ret = ew.pct_change()
print(f'EW market 1m: {ew.iloc[-1]/ew.iloc[-22]-1:.4f}  3m: {ew.iloc[-1]/ew.iloc[-66]-1:.4f}')
print(f'EW market 6m: {ew.iloc[-1]/ew.iloc[-132]-1:.4f}')
print(f'EW vol20 ann: {ew_ret.iloc[-20:].std()*np.sqrt(252)*100:.1f}%')

print('\nVIX last:', vix.iloc[-1].to_dict())

import json, base64, zlib, io, pandas as pd, numpy as np

def load_signal(f):
    d = json.load(open(f))
    art = d['validation']['signal_artifact']
    fmt = art['format']
    if 'base64' in fmt:
        raw = base64.b64decode(art['data'])
        df = pd.read_csv(io.BytesIO(zlib.decompress(raw)))
        df = df.set_index(df.columns[0])
        df.index = pd.to_datetime(df.index)
    else:
        df = pd.DataFrame(art['values'], index=pd.to_datetime(art['dates']), columns=art['assets'])
    return df.sort_index()

for f in ['factors/vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60.json','factors/dn_mkt_beta_60d.json','factors/rate_beta_cn10y_60d.json']:
    df = load_signal(f)
    print(f.split('/')[-1], 'shape', df.shape, 'range', df.index.min().date(), '->', df.index.max().date())
    # last 10 rows valid
    print('   last valid date row non-null count:', df.iloc[-1].notna().sum())

import json, base64, zlib, io, pandas as pd, numpy as np

def load_signal(f):
    d = json.load(open(f))
    art = d['validation']['signal_artifact']
    fmt = art['format']
    if 'base64' in fmt:
        raw = base64.b64decode(art['data'])
        df = pd.read_csv(io.BytesIO(zlib.decompress(raw)))
        df = df.set_index(df.columns[0]); df.index = pd.to_datetime(df.index)
    else:
        df = pd.DataFrame(art['values'], index=pd.to_datetime(art['dates']), columns=art['assets'])
    return df.sort_index()

# Prices
assets = ['000300.SH','000688.SH','SPX','NDX','SOX','HSI','N225','SX5E','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
px={}
for a in assets:
    df=pd.read_csv(f'../persistent/stock_data/{a}.csv')
    df['date']=pd.to_datetime(df['date']); df=df.set_index('date').sort_index()
    px[a]=df['close']
PX=pd.DataFrame(px); PX=PX[~PX.index.duplicated(keep='last')].sort_index()
PX=PX[PX.index<='2028-10-20']

def ic_series(sig, fwd, min_valid=8):
    dates=[]; ics=[]
    for t in sig.index:
        s=sig.loc[t].dropna()
        if len(s)<min_valid: continue
        # forward 10d returns starting t
        t10 = PX.index.searchsorted(t + pd.Timedelta(days=1))
        if t10+9 >= len(PX.index): continue
        fwd_ret = PX.iloc[t10+9]/PX.iloc[t10]-1
        fwd_ret = fwd_ret.reindex(s.index)
        mask = fwd_ret.notna()
        if mask.sum()<min_valid: continue
        ic = np.corrcoef(s[mask], fwd_ret[mask])[0,1]
        if np.isfinite(ic):
            dates.append(t); ics.append(ic)
    return pd.Series(ics, index=pd.DatetimeIndex(dates))

sig = load_signal('factors/vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60.json')
ic = ic_series(sig, 10)
print('=== vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60 IC by year (h=10) ===')
for y in sorted(set(ic.index.year)):
    s=ic[ic.index.year==y]
    print(f'{y}: n={len(s):4d} mean_ic={s.mean():+.4f} icir={s.mean()/s.std():+.3f} hit={(s>0).mean():.3f}')
print('recent 2027-09..2028-03:', f'n={len(ic[ic.index>="2027-09-01"])} mean_ic={ic[ic.index>="2027-09-01"].mean():+.4f}')

# full-window IC for the two beta factors (through 2026-07)
for f in ['factors/dn_mkt_beta_60d.json','factors/rate_beta_cn10y_60d.json']:
    sig2 = load_signal(f)
    ic2 = ic_series(sig2, 10)
    print(f'\n=== {f.split("/")[-1]} IC by year ===')
    for y in sorted(set(ic2.index.year)):
        s=ic2[ic2.index.year==y]
        if len(s)>5:
            print(f'{y}: n={len(s):4d} mean_ic={s.mean():+.4f} icir={s.mean()/s.std():+.3f} hit={(s>0).mean():.3f}')
EOF

python << 'EOF'
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, glob, os

files = sorted(glob.glob('../persistent/stock_data/*.csv'))
names = [os.path.basename(f)[:-4] for f in files]
data = {}
for f, n in zip(files, names):
    try:
        df = pd.read_csv(f)
        df.columns = [c.strip() for c in df.columns]
        date_col = 'date' if 'date' in df.columns else df.columns[0]
        df[date_col] = pd.to_datetime(df[date_col])
        df = df.sort_values(date_col).set_index(date_col)
        close_col = 'close' if 'close' in df.columns else 'Close'
        data[n] = df[close_col].astype(float)
    except Exception as e:
        print(n, 'ERR', e)

px = pd.DataFrame(data).dropna(how='all')
px = px.ffill()
last = px.index[-1]
print('last date:', last.date())

# returns
r = px.pct_change()
r5 = px.pct_change(5).iloc[-1]
r21 = px.pct_change(21).iloc[-1]
r63 = px.pct_change(63).iloc[-1]
print('\n=== Returns (%%) as of', last.date(), '===')
print(pd.DataFrame({'5d': r5*100, '21d': r21*100, '63d': r63*100}).round(2).to_string())

# 21d realized vol annualized
vol21 = r.tail(21).std() * np.sqrt(252) * 100
print('\n=== 21d realized vol (ann %) ===')
print(vol21.round(1).sort_values(ascending=False).to_string())

# average cross-sectional correlation (21d)
r21w = r.tail(21)
corr = r21w.corr()
vals = corr.values[np.triu_indices_from(corr.values, k=1)]
print('\navg pairwise corr (21d):', round(np.nanmean(vals), 3))

# dispersion: std of 21d returns across assets
print('cross-sectional dispersion of 21d rets: %.2f%%' % (r21.std()*100))

# trend: 63d slope relative to vol
print('\n=== Trend / regime ===')
for n in names:
    s = px[n].dropna()
    if len(s) < 130: continue
    ma50 = s.iloc[-1] / s.tail(50).mean() - 1
    ma200 = s.iloc[-1] / s.tail(200).mean() - 1
    print(f'{n:12s} px={s.iloc[-1]:10.2f} vsMA50={ma50*100:6.1f}% vsMA200={ma200*100:6.1f}%')
EOF

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, json

ASSETS = ['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
VIS = '2028-12-01'

closes = {}
for a in ASSETS:
    df = pd.read_csv(f'../persistent/stock_data/{a}.csv')
    df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
    df = df[df['date'] <= VIS].set_index('date').sort_index()
    closes[a] = df['close'].astype(float)

# build panel of returns (inner join)
panel = pd.concat({a: closes[a].pct_change() for a in ASSETS}, axis=1).dropna()
print('panel dates:', panel.index[0].date(), '->', panel.index[-1].date(), 'rows:', len(panel))

# factor values as of last date
def rolling_beta(y, x, win=60, min_obs=40):
    z = pd.concat([y, x], axis=1).dropna().tail(win)
    if len(z) < min_obs: return None
    var = float(z.iloc[:,1].var())
    if var <= 1e-14: return None
    return float(z.iloc[:,0].cov(z.iloc[:,1])/var)

def vol_adj_mom_accel(c, fast=20, slow=60, vol_win=20):
    r = c.pct_change()
    mom_fast = c/c.shift(fast)-1
    mom_slow = c/c.shift(slow)-1
    vol = r.rolling(vol_win).std()
    z = ((mom_fast-mom_slow)/vol).dropna()
    if len(z)<1: return None
    v = float(z.iloc[-1])
    return v if np.isfinite(v) else None

mkt = panel.mean(axis=1)
dn_x = mkt.clip(upper=0.0)

vals = {'vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60':{}, 'dn_mkt_beta_60d':{}, 'rate_beta_cn10y_60d':{}}
cn10y_ret = closes['CN10Y'].pct_change()
for a in ASSETS:
    c = closes[a]
    y = panel[a]
    vals['vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60'][a] = vol_adj_mom_accel(c)
    vals['dn_mkt_beta_60d'][a] = rolling_beta(y, dn_x)
    vals['rate_beta_cn10y_60d'][a] = rolling_beta(y, cn10y_ret)

def ranks(d):
    valid = sorted((float(v),a) for a,v in d.items() if v is not None and np.isfinite(float(v)))
    out = {a:0.5 for a in ASSETS}
    for i,(_,a) in enumerate(valid):
        out[a] = i/max(1,len(valid)-1)
    return out

# current ensemble
ens = [('vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60',0.46,1),('dn_mkt_beta_60d',0.34,1),('rate_beta_cn10y_60d',0.20,-1)]
score = {a:0.0 for a in ASSETS}
for fid,wgt,drc in ens:
    r = ranks(vals[fid])
    for a in ASSETS:
        score[a] += wgt*drc*r[a]

print('\nraw factor values as of', VIS)
for fid in vals:
    print(fid)
    for a in ASSETS:
        v = vals[fid][a]
        print(f'   {a:10s} {v if v is None else round(v,4)}')
print('\ncomposite score (current ensemble weights):')
for a in sorted(ASSETS, key=lambda x:-score[x]):
    print(f'   {a:10s} {score[a]:+.4f}')
print('\n20d vol:')
for a in ASSETS:
    print(f'   {a:10s} {panel[a].tail(20).std():.4f}')

python - <<'EOF'
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, json

ASSETS = ['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
VIS = '2028-12-01'

closes = {}
for a in ASSETS:
    df = pd.read_csv(f'../persistent/stock_data/{a}.csv')
    df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
    df = df[df['date'] <= VIS].set_index('date').sort_index()
    closes[a] = df['close'].astype(float)

panel = pd.concat({a: closes[a].pct_change() for a in ASSETS}, axis=1).dropna()
mkt = panel.mean(axis=1)
dn_x = mkt.clip(upper=0.0)
cn10y_ret = closes['CN10Y'].pct_change()

def rolling_beta_series(y, x, win=60, min_obs=40):
    # daily rolling beta
    out = {}
    z = pd.concat([y.rename('y'), x.rename('x')], axis=1).dropna()
    for i in range(len(z)):
        sub = z.iloc[max(0,i-win+1):i+1]
        if len(sub) < min_obs: continue
        var = sub.x.var()
        if var <= 1e-14: continue
        out[z.index[i]] = sub.y.cov(sub.x)/var
    return pd.Series(out)

def vol_adj_mom_accel_series(c, fast=20, slow=60, vol_win=20):
    r = c.pct_change()
    mom_fast = c/c.shift(fast)-1
    mom_slow = c/c.shift(slow)-1
    vol = r.rolling(vol_win).std()
    z = (mom_fast-mom_slow)/vol
    return z

# compute factor series per asset (aligned on panel index)
fac = {'vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60':{}, 'dn_mkt_beta_60d':{}, 'rate_beta_cn10y_60d':{}}
for a in ASSETS:
    fac['vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60'][a] = vol_adj_mom_accel_series(closes[a]).reindex(panel.index)
    fac['dn_mkt_beta_60d'][a] = rolling_beta_series(panel[a], dn_x).reindex(panel.index)
    fac['rate_beta_cn10y_60d'][a] = rolling_beta_series(panel[a], cn10y_ret.reindex(panel.index)).reindex(panel.index)

# forward 10d returns
fwd = panel.shift(-10)
# daily rank IC per factor (cross-sectional spearman)
def daily_ic(fvals, fwd):
    ics = []
    for dt in fvals.index:
        f = fvals.loc[dt]
        r = fwd.loc[dt]
        m = f.notna() & r.notna()
        if m.sum() < 6: continue
        ics.append((dt, f[m].rank().corr(r[m].rank())))
    return pd.Series(dict(ics))

ic_series = {fid: daily_ic(pd.DataFrame(fac[fid]), fwd) for fid in fac}

for fid in fac:
    s = ic_series[fid].dropna()
    for label, sl in [('last60', s.tail(60)), ('last120', s.tail(120)), ('last250', s.tail(250))]:
        ic = sl.mean(); icir = sl.mean()/ (sl.std()/np.sqrt(len(sl))) if sl.std()>0 else 0
        print(f'{fid:24s} {label}: n={len(sl):3d} IC={ic:+.4f} ICIR={icir:+.3f} hit={((sl>0).mean()):.2f}')
    print()

python - <<'EOF'
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, glob, os

files = sorted(glob.glob('../persistent/stock_data/*.csv'))
assets = [os.path.basename(f)[:-4] for f in files]
print("assets:", assets)

data = {}
for f, a in zip(files, assets):
    df = pd.read_csv(f)
    df.columns = [c.strip().lower() for c in df.columns]
    df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
    df = df.sort_values('date').set_index('date')
    data[a] = df['close']

px = pd.DataFrame(data).dropna(how='all')
px = px[px.index <= '2028-12-29']
ret = px.pct_change()

last = px.index[-1]
print("last date:", last.date(), "n days:", len(px))

# 60d return
r60 = px.iloc[-1] / px.iloc[-61] - 1
r20 = px.iloc[-1] / px.iloc[-21] - 1
r5 = px.iloc[-1] / px.iloc[-6] - 1
vol20 = ret.iloc[-20:].std() * np.sqrt(252)
vol60 = ret.iloc[-60:].std() * np.sqrt(252)
ma20 = px.iloc[-20:].mean()
ma60 = px.iloc[-60:].mean()
ma_slope = (px.iloc[-1] / px.iloc[-21] - 1) / 20  # proxy for MA slope direction
above_ma20 = px.iloc[-1] > ma20
above_ma60 = px.iloc[-1] > ma60

summary = pd.DataFrame({
    'r5': r5, 'r20': r20, 'r60': r60,
    'vol20_ann': vol20, 'vol60_ann': vol60,
    'above_ma20': above_ma20, 'above_ma60': above_ma60,
})
print(summary.round(4).to_string())

# Market breadth: fraction above MA60
print("\nbreadth above MA60:", above_ma60.mean().round(3))
print("breadth above MA20:", above_ma20.mean().round(3))
print("median 60d ret:", r60.median().round(4), "mean:", r60.mean().round(4))

# Cross-sectional dispersion of 60d returns
print("cross-section std of r60:", r60.std().round(4))
# Average pairwise correlation over last 60d
corr = ret.iloc[-60:].corr()
vals = corr.values[np.triu_indices(len(corr), k=1)]
print("avg pairwise corr (60d):", np.nanmean(vals).round(3))

# VIX level from index_data
vix = pd.read_csv('../persistent/index_data/VIX.csv')
vix.columns = [c.strip().lower() for c in vix.columns]
vix['date'] = pd.to_datetime(vix['date'])
vix = vix.sort_values('date').set_index('date')
print("\nVIX last:", vix['close'].iloc[-1].round(2), "60d ago:", vix['close'].iloc[-61].round(2) if len(vix)>60 else "na")
EOF

"""Screener cycle 2029-01-01: regime assessment + recent live IC for active factors.
Data visible window: <= 2028-12-29 (last completed trading day before decision date).
No backtest/step usage; pure factor analytics on the 15-asset cross-section.
"""
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, glob, os, json

CUT = '2028-12-29'

# ---- load 15 tradable assets ----
files = sorted(glob.glob('../persistent/stock_data/*.csv'))
px = {}
for f in files:
    sym = os.path.basename(f).replace('.csv', '')
    df = pd.read_csv(f)
    df.columns = [c.strip().lower() for c in df.columns]
    df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
    df = df.set_index('date').sort_index()
    px[sym] = df['close'].astype(float)
px = pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index()
px = px[px.index <= CUT]

print('visible data range:', px.index.min().date(), '->', px.index.max().date(), '| rows', len(px))

# stale / frozen detection: identical closes in last 5 days
def is_stale(c):
    tail = c.iloc[-6:]
    return bool((tail.diff().dropna().abs() < 1e-12).all())
stale = [c for c in px.columns if is_stale(px[c])]
print('stale/frozen:', stale)
live = [c for c in px.columns if c not in stale]

# ---- macro observation signals ----
def load_idx(sym):
    df = pd.read_csv(f'../persistent/index_data/{sym}.csv')
    df.columns = [c.strip().lower() for c in df.columns]
    df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
    return df.set_index('date').sort_index()['close'].astype(float)

macro = {s: load_idx(s) for s in ['DXY', 'VIX', 'EURUSD', 'USDJPY', 'USDCNY']}
for s in macro:
    macro[s] = macro[s][macro[s].index <= CUT]

# ---- regime stats ----
rets = px.pct_change()
mkt = rets[live].mean(axis=1)  # equal-weight live-asset market

for w in [20, 60, 120]:
    r = (1 + mkt).rolling(w).apply(np.prod, raw=True) - 1
    print(f'mkt(live) {w:3d}d cum return: {r.iloc[-1]*100:+.2f}%')

for w in [20, 60]:
    v = mkt.rolling(w).std() * np.sqrt(252)
    print(f'mkt(live) {w:3d}d realized vol (ann): {v.iloc[-1]*100:.1f}%')

cs_ret20 = (1 + rets[live]).rolling(20).apply(np.prod, raw=True) - 1
cs_disp = cs_ret20.std(axis=1)
print(f'cross-sectional dispersion of 20d returns (live): last={cs_disp.iloc[-1]*100:.2f}%  '
      f'3m mean={cs_disp.iloc[-65:].mean()*100:.2f}%  1y mean={cs_disp.iloc[-252:].mean()*100:.2f}%')

corr_vals = []
for d in rets[live].index[-60:]:
    c = rets[live].loc[d-60:d].corr()
    vals = c.values[np.triu_indices_from(c.values, k=1)]
    corr_vals.append(np.nanmean(vals))
print('avg pairwise corr (live, 60d): last=%.3f  mean_3m=%.3f' % (corr_vals[-1], np.mean(corr_vals[-65:])))

for s in ['VIX', 'DXY', 'USDJPY', 'EURUSD', 'USDCNY']:
    x = macro[s]
    print(f'{s}: last={x.iloc[-1]:.2f}  60d ago={x.iloc[-61]:.2f}' if len(x) > 61 else f'{s}: last={x.iloc[-1]:.2f}')

# asset 60d returns / vol
print('\n=== asset snapshot (60d ret, 20d vol ann) ===')
r60 = px.iloc[-1] / px.iloc[-61] - 1
vol20 = rets.iloc[-20:].std() * np.sqrt(252)
snap = pd.DataFrame({'r60': r60, 'vol20': vol20}).round(4)
print(snap.to_string())

# ---- factor computation ----
def rolling_beta(y, x, win=60, min_obs=40):
    out = pd.Series(index=y.index, dtype=float)
    for i in range(len(y)):
        if i < win:
            continue
        ys, xs = y.iloc[i-win:i], x.iloc[i-win:i]
        m = ys.notna() & xs.notna()
        if m.sum() < min_obs:
            continue
        out.iloc[i] = np.polyfit(xs[m], ys[m], 1)[0]
    return out

dnmkt = mkt.where(mkt < 0, 0.0)
f_dn = pd.DataFrame(index=px.index, columns=px.columns, dtype=float)
f_cn = pd.DataFrame(index=px.index, columns=px.columns, dtype=float)
f_mom = pd.DataFrame(index=px.index, columns=px.columns, dtype=float)
for c in px.columns:
    f_dn[c] = rolling_beta(rets[c], dnmkt, 60, 40)
    f_cn[c] = rolling_beta(rets[c], px['CN10Y'].pct_change(), 60, 40)
    r20 = px[c] / px[c].shift(20) - 1
    r60 = px[c] / px[c].shift(60) - 1
    v20 = rets[c].rolling(20).std()
    f_mom[c] = (r20 - r60) / v20

facs = {'vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60': f_mom, 'dn_mkt_beta_60d': f_dn, 'rate_beta_cn10y_60d': f_cn}

fwd = px.shift(-10) / px - 1

def rank_ic(fval, fwd10, start, end, min_valid=6, assets=None):
    fv = fval.loc[start:end]
    fr = fwd10.loc[start:end]
    ics = []
    for d in fv.index:
        x = fv.loc[d]
        y = fr.loc[d]
        if assets is not None:
            x = x[assets]
            y = y[assets]
        m = x.notna() & y.notna()
        if m.sum() < min_valid:
            continue
        ics.append((d, x[m].rank().corr(y[m].rank())))
    if not ics:
        return None
    return pd.Series(dict(ics))

print('\n=== recent rank IC (h=10), LIVE assets only ===')
windows = [('2028 YTD', '2028-01-01', CUT),
           ('last 6m', '2028-06-01', CUT),
           ('last 3m', '2028-09-01', CUT),
           ('last 90td', None, None),
           ('last 60td', None, None),
           ('last 40td', None, None)]
for label, a, b in windows:
    if a is None:
        a = px.index[-91]
        b = px.index[-1]
    print(f'--- {label} ({a.date()}..{b.date()}) ---')
    for name, fv in facs.items():
        s = rank_ic(fv, fwd, a, b, assets=live)
        if s is None or len(s) == 0:
            print(f'  {name}: no data')
            continue
        ic = s.mean()
        icir = s.mean() / s.std() if s.std() > 0 else np.nan
        hit = (np.sign(s) > 0).mean()
        print(f'  {name}: n={len(s):3d} IC={ic:+.4f} ICIR={icir:+.3f} hit={hit:.2f}')

# ---- factor correlation (last 90td, live) ----
print('\n=== factor exposure correlation (last 90td, live) ===')
fdf = pd.DataFrame({k: fv[live].mean(axis=1) for k, fv in facs.items()}).iloc[-90:]
print(fdf.corr().round(3).to_string())

# ---- latest factor cross-section ----
print('\n=== latest factor exposures (2028-12-29, live) ===')
last = px.index[-1]
for name, fv in facs.items():
    x = fv.loc[last].dropna().sort_values()
    print(f'{name}:')
    print('   low :', x.head(6).round(3).to_dict())
    print('   high:', x.tail(6).round(3).to_dict())

# ---- decay: IC by horizon (last 6m) ----
print('\n=== IC by horizon (last 6m, live) ===')
for h in [1, 2, 3, 5, 10, 20]:
    fw = px.shift(-h) / px - 1
    row = []
    for name, fv in facs.items():
        s = rank_ic(fv, fw, '2028-06-01', CUT, assets=live)
        row.append(f'{name}={s.mean():+.4f}' if s is not None and len(s) else f'{name}=na')
    print(f'h={h:2d}: ' + '  '.join(row))

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, glob, os
pd.set_option('display.width', 250); pd.set_option('display.max_columns', 50)

asof = '2029-01-15'
def load(f):
    df = pd.read_csv(f)
    df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
    df = df[df['date'] <= asof].sort_values('date').reset_index(drop=True)
    return df

assets = ['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
px = {}
for a in assets:
    df = load(f'../persistent/stock_data/{a}.csv')
    px[a] = df.set_index('date')['close']

PX = pd.DataFrame(px).dropna(how='all')
print('Date range:', PX.index.min().date(), '->', PX.index.max().date(), '| rows:', len(PX))

ret = PX.pct_change()
last = PX.iloc[-1]
r10 = (PX.iloc[-1]/PX.iloc[-11]-1)*100 if len(PX)>10 else np.nan
r20 = (PX.iloc[-1]/PX.iloc[-21]-1)*100 if len(PX)>20 else np.nan
r60 = (PX.iloc[-1]/PX.iloc[-61]-1)*100 if len(PX)>60 else np.nan
vol20 = ret.tail(20).std()*np.sqrt(252)*100
vol60 = ret.tail(60).std()*np.sqrt(252)*100
ma20 = PX.tail(20).mean()
ma60 = PX.tail(60).mean()
trend = np.where(PX.iloc[-1]>ma20, 1, 0) + np.where(ma20>ma60,1,0)  # 2=strong up,1=mixed,0=down
# 60d max drawdown
dd = {}
for a in assets:
    s = PX[a].dropna().tail(130)
    if len(s)<30: dd[a]=np.nan; continue
    peak = s.cummax(); d = (s/peak-1).min()*100
    dd[a]=d
out = pd.DataFrame({'last':last.values, 'r10':r10.values, 'r20':r20.values, 'r60':r60.values, 'vol20':vol20.values, 'vol60':vol60.values, 'ma20up':(PX.iloc[-1]>ma20).values, 'ma20>ma60':(ma20>ma60).values, 'dd130d':[dd[a] for a in assets]}, index=assets)
print(out.round(2).to_string())
print()
print('CROSS-SECTIONAL dispersion (avg pairwise corr of 20d returns, last 60d):')
c = ret.tail(60).corr(min_periods=20)
print('mean pairwise corr:', round(c.values[np.triu_indices(len(c),1)][~np.isnan(c.values[np.triu_indices(len(c),1)])].mean(),3))
print('median pairwise corr:', round(np.nanmedian(c.values[np.triu_indices(len(c),1)]),3))
"

X=pd.DataFrame(rets).dropna()

c=X.tail(60).corr()
# mean pairwise corr
vals=c.values; np.fill_diagonal(vals,np.nan)
print('mean pairwise corr (60d):', round(np.nanmean(vals),3))
# dispersion: cross-sectional std of 20d returns
r20=(1+X.tail(20)).prod()-1
print('cross-sectional std of 20d rets:', round(r20.std()*100,1),'%')
print('top:', r20.idxmax(), round(r20.max()*100,1), 'bottom:', r20.idxmin(), round(r20.min()*100,1))
"

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, glob, os

files = sorted(glob.glob('../persistent/stock_data/*.csv'))
assets = [os.path.basename(f).replace('.csv','') for f in files]
data = {}
for f, a in zip(files, assets):
    df = pd.read_csv(f)
    df.columns = [c.strip().lower() for c in df.columns]
    if 'date' not in df.columns:
        df = df.reset_index()
        df.columns = ['date'] + list(df.columns[1:])
    df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
    df = df.sort_values('date').set_index('date')
    data[a] = df['close'].dropna()

px = pd.DataFrame(data)
px = px.loc[px.index <= '2029-03-09']
rets = px.pct_change()

last = px.index[-1]
print('last date:', last.date())

def ann_vol(s, win=20):
    return s.tail(win).std() * np.sqrt(252)

rows = {}
for a in assets:
    r = rets[a].dropna()
    r10 = (1+r.tail(10)).prod()-1
    r20 = (1+r.tail(20)).prod()-1
    r60 = (1+r.tail(60)).prod()-1
    vol20 = ann_vol(r)
    ma60 = px[a].tail(60).mean()
    above_ma = px[a].iloc[-1] > ma60
    rows[a] = dict(r10=r10, r20=r20, r60=r60, vol20=vol20, above_ma60=above_ma)

tab = pd.DataFrame(rows).T
print(tab.round(4).to_string())

print('\n=== Cross-sectional stats (last 10d) ===')
r10x = tab['r10']
print('mean asset 10d ret: %.3f%%  median %.3f%%  dispersion(std) %.3f%%' % (r10x.mean()*100, r10x.median()*100, r10x.std()*100))
print('winners(>0):', (r10x>0).sum(), 'losers(<0):', (r10x<0).sum())
print('mean asset 20d ret: %.3f%%' % (tab['r20'].mean()*100))
print('mean asset 60d ret: %.3f%%' % (tab['r60'].mean()*100))
print('median vol20 ann: %.1f%%  max: %.1f%% (asset?)' % (tab['vol20'].median()*100, tab['vol20'].max()*100))
print('above 60d MA count:', tab['above_ma60'].sum(), '/15')

# VIX read
vix = pd.read_csv('../persistent/index_data/VIX.csv')
vix.columns = [c.strip().lower() for c in vix.columns]
vix['date'] = pd.to_datetime(vix['date'])
vix = vix.sort_values('date').set_index('date')
print('\nVIX last close: %.1f  (1m ago: %.1f, 3m ago: %.1f)' % (vix['close'].iloc[-1], vix['close'].iloc[-22], vix['close'].iloc[-64]))

# correlation regime: mean pairwise correlation of daily returns last 60d
corr = rets.tail(60).corr()
vals = corr.values[np.triu_indices(len(corr), 1)]
print('mean pairwise corr (60d): %.3f  median %.3f' % (np.nanmean(vals), np.nanmedian(vals)))
EOF

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, glob

CUTOFF = pd.Timestamp('2029-04-09')

def load(path):
    df = pd.read_csv(path)
    df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
    df = df[df['date'] <= CUTOFF].copy()
    return df.set_index('date')['close']

px = {}
for a in assets:
    try:
        s = load(f'../persistent/stock_data/{a}.csv')
        px[a] = s
    except Exception as e:
        print(a, 'ERR', e)

p = pd.DataFrame(px)
print('panel shape:', p.shape, 'last date:', p.index.max())

def ret(s, n):
    return s.iloc[-1]/s.iloc[-1-n] - 1 if len(s) > n else np.nan

rows = []
for a in assets:
    s = p[a].dropna()
    if len(s) < 70:
        rows.append(dict(asset=a, last=np.nan, r20=np.nan, r60=np.nan, vol20=np.nan, vs20ma=np.nan, vs60ma=np.nan, n=len(s)))

    r20 = ret(s, 20); r60 = ret(s, 60)

# pairwise correlation of 20d returns

c = rets.corr()

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, glob, os

    df = pd.read_csv(p)
    df.columns = [c.strip().lower() for c in df.columns]
    datecol = 'date' if 'date' in df.columns else df.columns[0]
    df[datecol] = pd.to_datetime(df[datecol])
    df = df.sort_values(datecol).reset_index(drop=True)
    return df, datecol

assets = ['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
obs = ['DXY','USDCNY','USDJPY','EURUSD','VIX']

print("=== TRADABLE ASSETS ===")
rows=[]
for a in assets:
    p = f'../persistent/stock_data/{a}.csv'
    if not os.path.exists(p): 
        print(a,'MISSING'); continue
    df,dc = load(p)
    last = df[dc].iloc[-1].date()
    close = df['close'] if 'close' in df.columns else df[df.columns[1]]
    close = pd.to_numeric(close, errors='coerce')
    ret = close.pct_change()
    def r(n): 
        return (close.iloc[-1]/close.iloc[-1-n]-1) if len(close)>n else np.nan
    vol = ret.tail(20).std()*np.sqrt(252)
    ma20 = close.rolling(20).mean().iloc[-1]
    ma60 = close.rolling(60).mean().iloc[-1]
    slope = (ma20/ma60-1) if ma60>0 else np.nan
    dd = (close/close.cummax()-1).min()

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, os

CUR = pd.Timestamp('2029-05-21')
assets = ['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']

def load_close(a):
    df = pd.read_csv(f'../persistent/stock_data/{a}.csv')
    df.columns = [c.strip().lower() for c in df.columns]
    dc = 'date' if 'date' in df.columns else df.columns[0]
    df[dc] = pd.to_datetime(df[dc])
    df = df.sort_values(dc).reset_index(drop=True)
    df = df[df[dc] <= CUR]
    s = pd.to_numeric(df['close'], errors='coerce')
    s.index = df[dc]
    return s.dropna()

closes = {a: load_close(a) for a in assets}
ret = pd.DataFrame({a: closes[a].pct_change() for a in assets}).dropna(how='all')

# forward 10d returns (close t+10 / close t - 1) - using close data
fwd = pd.DataFrame({a: closes[a].shift(-10)/closes[a] - 1 for a in assets})

# --- factor values ---
def rolling_beta(y, x, win=60):
    d = pd.concat([y.rename('y'), x.rename('x')], axis=1).dropna()
    out = pd.Series(index=d.index, dtype=float)
    for i in range(win-1, len(d)):
        w = d.iloc[i-win+1:i+1]
        vx = w['x'].var()
        if vx <= 1e-14: 
            out.iloc[i] = np.nan
        else:
            out.iloc[i] = w['y'].cov(w['x'])/vx
    return out

mkt = ret.mean(axis=1, min_count=8)
dn_x = mkt.clip(upper=0.0)

fac = {}
# dn_mkt_beta_60d
fac['dn_mkt_beta_60d'] = pd.DataFrame({a: rolling_beta(ret[a], dn_x, 60) for a in assets})
# rate_beta_cn10y_60d
cn10y_r = ret['CN10Y']
fac['rate_beta_cn10y_60d'] = pd.DataFrame({a: rolling_beta(ret[a], cn10y_r, 60) for a in assets})
# vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60
def vama(c, fast=20, slow=60, vol_win=20):
    r = c.pct_change()
    mom_fast = c/c.shift(fast)-1
    mom_slow = c/c.shift(slow)-1
    vol = r.rolling(vol_win).std()
    z = (mom_fast-mom_slow)/vol
    return z
fac['vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60'] = pd.DataFrame({a: vama(closes[a]) for a in assets})

# --- IC computation ---
def ic_series(fv, fwd, min_valid=8):
    dates, ics = [], []
    common = fv.index.intersection(fwd.index)
    for d in common:
        f = fv.loc[d]; r = fwd.loc[d]
        m = f.notna() & r.notna()
        if m.sum() < min_valid: continue
        ic = f[m].rank().corr(r[m].rank())
        if pd.notna(ic): dates.append(d); ics.append(ic)
    return pd.Series(ics, index=dates)

def ic_stats(ics):
    if len(ics) < 5: return None
    return dict(n=len(ics), ic=ics.mean(), icir=ics.mean()/ics.std() if ics.std()>0 else np.nan,
                hit=(ics>0).mean())

print(f"{'factor':26s} {'window':>8s} {'n':>5s} {'IC':>8s} {'ICIR':>7s} {'hit':>6s} {'q=IC*ICIR':>10s}")
res={}
for fname, fv in fac.items():
    ics_all = ic_series(fv, fwd)
    ics_250 = ics_all[ics_all.index >= CUR - pd.Timedelta(days=400)].tail(250)
    ics_125 = ics_all[ics_all.index >= CUR - pd.Timedelta(days=200)].tail(125)
    for wname, ics in [('all', ics_all), ('250d', ics_250), ('125d', ics_125)]:
        st = ic_stats(ics)
        if st:
            q = abs(st['ic'])*abs(st['icir'])
            print(f"{fname:26s} {wname:>8s} {st['n']:5d} {st['ic']:8.4f} {st['icir']:7.3f} {st['hit']:6.2f} {q:10.5f}")
            res[(fname,wname)]=st

# factor cross-correlation (recent 250d common dates)
print()
print("=== factor pairwise rank corr (last 250d) ===")
for a in ['dn_mkt_beta_60d','rate_beta_cn10y_60d','vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60']:
    for b in ['dn_mkt_beta_60d','rate_beta_cn10y_60d','vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60']:
        if a>=b: continue
        x=fac[a]; y=fac[b]
        common = x.index.intersection(y.index)
        xr = x.loc[common].rank(axis=1); yr = y.loc[common].rank(axis=1)
        cc=[]
        for d in common:
            m = xr.loc[d].notna() & yr.loc[d].notna()
            if m.sum()<8: continue
            v = xr.loc[d][m].corr(yr.loc[d][m])
            if pd.notna(v): cc.append(v)
        cc = pd.Series(cc)
        cc250 = cc[cc.index >= CUR-pd.Timedelta(days=400)].tail(250)
        print(f"{a} vs {b}: all {cc.mean():.3f} (n={len(cc)}), last250 {cc250.mean():.3f} (n={len(cc250)})")

import pandas as pd, numpy as np

assets = ['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
px = {}
for a in assets:
    df = pd.read_csv(f'../persistent/stock_data/{a}.csv')
    df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
    df = df[df['date'] <= '2029-06-01'].set_index('date')
    px[a] = df['close']
PX = pd.DataFrame(px).dropna(how='all')
ret = PX.pct_change()

# ---- Factor constructions ----
# 1) vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60: (mom20 - mom60)/std20
mom20 = PX/PX.shift(20)-1
mom60 = PX/PX.shift(60)-1
std20 = ret.rolling(20).std()
f_mom = (mom20 - mom60)/std20

# 2) dn_mkt_beta_60d: beta(asset_ret, min(mkt,0), 60), mkt = EW mean
mkt = ret.mean(axis=1)
dm = np.minimum(mkt, 0)
f_beta = ret.rolling(60).cov(dm)/dm.rolling(60).var()

# 3) rate_beta_cn10y_60d: beta(asset_ret, pct_change(CN10Y), 60)
cn10y = PX['CN10Y']
dcn = cn10y.pct_change()
f_rate = ret.rolling(60).cov(dcn)/dcn.rolling(60).var()

factors = {'vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60': f_mom, 'dn_mkt_beta_60d': f_beta, 'rate_beta_cn10y_60d': f_rate}

# ---- Rolling IC at h=10 ----
fwd = ret.shift(-10)
def ic_series(f, fwd, win=252):
    out = {}
    for a in assets:
        s = pd.concat([f[a], fwd[a]], axis=1).dropna()
        out[a] = s.iloc[:,0].rolling(win).corr(s.iloc[:,1], method='spearman')
    return pd.DataFrame(out)

# compute IC on the cross-section directly (rank corr per date)
def xs_ic(f, fwd):
    ic = []
    dates = f.index
    for t in dates:
        x = f.loc[t]; y = fwd.loc[t]
        m = x.notna() & y.notna()
        if m.sum() >= 8:
            ic.append((t, x[m].rank().corr(y[m].rank())))
    s = pd.Series(dict(ic))
    return s.dropna()

fwd10 = ret.shift(-10)
ics = {}
for name, f in factors.items():
    s = xs_ic(f, fwd10)
    ics[name] = s

print('=== Recent IC stats (h=10) ===')
for name, s in ics.items():
    for label, sl in [('120d', s.tail(120)), ('252d', s.tail(252)), ('504d', s.tail(504)), ('all', s)]:

"""Screener cycle 2029-06-18: regime assessment + recent live IC for active factors.
Data visible window: <= 2029-06-15 (last completed trading day before decision date).
No backtest/step usage; pure factor analytics on the 15-asset cross-section.
"""
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, glob, os, json

CUT = '2029-06-15'

# ---- load 15 tradable assets ----
files = sorted(glob.glob('../persistent/stock_data/*.csv'))
px = {}
for f in files:
    sym = os.path.basename(f).replace('.csv', '')
    df = pd.read_csv(f)
    df.columns = [c.strip().lower() for c in df.columns]
    df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
    df = df.set_index('date').sort_index()
    px[sym] = df['close'].astype(float)
px = pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index()
px = px[px.index <= CUT]
print('visible data range:', px.index.min().date(), '->', px.index.max().date(), '| rows', len(px))

# stale / frozen detection: identical closes in last 5 days
def is_stale(c):
    tail = c.iloc[-6:]
    return bool((tail.diff().dropna().abs() < 1e-12).all())
stale = [c for c in px.columns if is_stale(px[c])]
print('stale/frozen:', stale)
live = [c for c in px.columns if c not in stale]

# ---- macro observation signals ----
def load_idx(sym):
    df = pd.read_csv(f'../persistent/index_data/{sym}.csv')
    df.columns = [c.strip().lower() for c in df.columns]
    df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
    return df.set_index('date').sort_index()['close'].astype(float)

macro = {s: load_idx(s) for s in ['DXY', 'VIX', 'EURUSD', 'USDJPY', 'USDCNY']}
for s in macro:
    macro[s] = macro[s][macro[s].index <= CUT]

# ---- regime stats ----
rets = px.pct_change()
mkt = rets[live].mean(axis=1)  # equal-weight live-asset market

print('\n=== regime ===')
for w in [20, 60, 120, 252]:
    r = (1 + mkt).rolling(w).apply(np.prod, raw=True) - 1
    print(f'mkt(live) {w:3d}d cum return: {r.iloc[-1]*100:+.2f}%')

for w in [20, 60]:
    v = mkt.rolling(w).std() * np.sqrt(252)
    print(f'mkt(live) {w:3d}d realized vol (ann): {v.iloc[-1]*100:.1f}%')

cs_ret20 = (1 + rets[live]).rolling(20).apply(np.prod, raw=True) - 1
cs_disp = cs_ret20.std(axis=1)
print(f'cross-sectional dispersion of 20d returns (live): last={cs_disp.iloc[-1]*100:.2f}%  '
      f'3m mean={cs_disp.iloc[-65:].mean()*100:.2f}%  1y mean={cs_disp.iloc[-252:].mean()*100:.2f}%')

corr_vals = []
for d in rets[live].index[-60:]:
    c = rets[live].loc[d-60:d].corr()
    vals = c.values[np.triu_indices_from(c.values, k=1)]
    corr_vals.append(np.nanmean(vals))
print('avg pairwise corr (live, 60d): last=%.3f  mean_3m=%.3f' % (corr_vals[-1], np.mean(corr_vals[-65:])))

for s in ['VIX', 'DXY', 'USDJPY', 'EURUSD', 'USDCNY']:
    x = macro[s]
    print(f'{s}: last={x.iloc[-1]:.2f}  60d ago={x.iloc[-61]:.2f}' if len(x) > 61 else f'{s}: last={x.iloc[-1]:.2f}')

print('\n=== asset snapshot (60d ret, 20d vol ann) ===')
r60 = px.iloc[-1] / px.iloc[-61] - 1
vol20 = rets.iloc[-20:].std() * np.sqrt(252)
snap = pd.DataFrame({'r60': r60, 'vol20': vol20}).round(4)
print(snap.to_string())

# MA trend of equal-weight market
ma20 = mkt.rolling(20).mean()
ma60 = mkt.rolling(60).mean()
ma200 = mkt.rolling(200).mean()
print(f'\nmkt vs MA20/MA60/MA200: {mkt.iloc[-1]*100:.2f} / {ma20.iloc[-1]*100:.2f} / {ma60.iloc[-1]*100:.2f} / {ma200.iloc[-1]*100:.2f}')

# individual asset MA position
print('\n=== asset MA position (last vs MA50/MA200) ===')
for a in live:
    c = px[a]
    ma50 = c.rolling(50).mean().iloc[-1]
    ma200 = c.rolling(200).mean().iloc[-1]
    last = c.iloc[-1]
    print(f'{a:10s} last={last:10.2f} vs MA50 {100*(last/ma50-1):+6.1f}%  vs MA200 {100*(last/ma200-1):+6.1f}%')

# ---- factor computation (match strategy.py) ----
print('\n=== factor recent IC (h=10 rank IC, direction-adjusted) ===')

def rolling_beta_series(y, x, win=60, min_obs=40):
    z = pd.concat([y.rename('y'), x.rename('x')], axis=1).dropna()
    out = pd.Series(index=y.index, dtype=float)
    for i in range(len(z)):
        if i < win:
            continue
        seg = z.iloc[i-win:i]
        if len(seg) < min_obs:
            continue
        var = float(seg.x.var())
        if var <= 1e-14:
            continue
        out.iloc[i] = float(seg.y.cov(seg.x) / var)
    return out

dnmkt = mkt.clip(upper=0.0)
cn10y_ret = px['CN10Y'].pct_change()

f_rates = pd.DataFrame(index=px.index, columns=px.columns, dtype=float)
f_dn = pd.DataFrame(index=px.index, columns=px.columns, dtype=float)
f_mom = pd.DataFrame(index=px.index, columns=px.columns, dtype=float)
for a in live:
    y = px[a].pct_change()
    f_rates[a] = rolling_beta_series(y, cn10y_ret, 60, 40)
    f_dn[a] = rolling_beta_series(y, dnmkt, 60, 40)
    r = px[a].pct_change()
    mom_fast = px[a] / px[a].shift(20) - 1.0
    mom_slow = px[a] / px[a].shift(60) - 1.0
    vol = r.rolling(20).std()
    f_mom[a] = (mom_fast - mom_slow) / vol

fwd = px.shift(-10) / px - 1.0

def rank_ic_series(fval, start, end, min_valid=6):
    fv = fval.loc[start:end]
    fr = fwd.loc[start:end]
    ics = []
    for d in fv.index:
        x = fv.loc[d]; y = fr.loc[d]
        m = x.notna() & y.notna()
        if m.sum() < min_valid:
            continue
        ics.append((d, x[m].rank().corr(y[m].rank())))
    if not ics:
        return pd.Series(dtype=float)
    return pd.Series(dict(ics))

fac_defs = {
    'rate_beta_cn10y_60d': (f_rates, -1),
    'dn_mkt_beta_60d': (f_dn, +1),
    'vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60': (f_mom, +1),
}

for name, (fv, direction) in fac_defs.items():
    print(f'\n--- {name} (dir {direction:+d}) ---')
    for label, win in [('90d', 90), ('180d', 180), ('252d', 252)]:
        start = px.index[-win]
        s = rank_ic_series(fv, start, CUT)
        if len(s) < 10:
            print(f'  {label}: n={len(s)} insufficient')
            continue
        ic = s.mean() * direction
        icir = ic / (s.std() / np.sqrt(len(s))) if s.std() > 0 else np.nan
        hit = (s * direction > 0).mean()
        print(f'  {label}: n={len(s):3d} adj_IC={ic:+.4f} ICIR={icir:+.3f} hit={hit*100:.0f}%')
    # long-run
    s = rank_ic_series(fv, px.index[-756], CUT)
    if len(s) >= 50:
        ic = s.mean() * direction
        icir = ic / (s.std() / np.sqrt(len(s))) if s.std() > 0 else np.nan
        print(f'  756d: n={len(s):3d} adj_IC={ic:+.4f} ICIR={icir:+.3f}')

# ---- pairwise factor IC correlation (252d) ----
print('\n=== pairwise factor IC correlation (252d) ===')
names = list(fac_defs.keys())
ic_series = {}
for name, (fv, direction) in fac_defs.items():
    s = rank_ic_series(fv, px.index[-252], CUT)
    ic_series[name] = s
import itertools
for a, b in itertools.combinations(names, 2):
    sa, sb = ic_series[a].align(ic_series[b], join='inner')
    if len(sa) >= 30:
        print(f'  {a} vs {b}: corr={sa.corr(sb):+.3f} (n={len(sa)})')

# ---- current signal snapshot (last visible date) ----
print('\n=== current factor signal snapshot (last visible date = %s) ===' % px.index[-1].date())
last_date = px.index[-1]
snap_out = {}
for name, (fv, direction) in fac_defs.items():
    row = fv.loc[last_date].dropna()
    # rank 0..1 (neutral = 0.5 for stale)
    r = row.rank(pct=True)
    snap_out[name] = r
    print(f'{name}:')
    for a in r.sort_values(ascending=False).index:
        print(f'    {a:10s} val={row[a]:+.4f} rank={r[a]:.2f}')

# composite z-score direction
print('\n=== composite ensemble tilt (weighted rank, dir-adjusted) ===')
ens = {'rate_beta_cn10y_60d': (0.45, -1), 'vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60': (0.35, +1), 'dn_mkt_beta_60d': (0.20, +1)}
comp = pd.Series(dtype=float)
for name, (w, d) in ens.items():
    comp = comp.add(snap_out[name] * d * w, fill_value=0.0)
# stale assets neutral (0.5 * sum weights) -> center
comp = comp - 0.5 * sum(w for w, _ in ens.values())
for a in comp.sort_values(ascending=False).index:
    print(f'    {a:10s} composite={comp[a]:+.4f}')

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, json

tradable = ['000300.SH','000688.SH','SPX','NDX','SOX','HSI','N225','SX5E','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
macro = ['VIX','DXY','USDCNY','USDJPY','EURUSD']
cut = pd.Timestamp('2029-07-13')

data = {}
for s in tradable:
    df = pd.read_csv(f'../persistent/stock_data/{s}.csv', parse_dates=['date'])
    df = df[df['date']<=cut].set_index('date').sort_index()
    data[s] = df['close']

mdata = {}
for s in macro:
    df = pd.read_csv(f'../persistent/index_data/{s}.csv', parse_dates=['date'])
    df = df[df['date']<=cut].set_index('date').sort_index()
    mdata[s] = df['close']

px = pd.DataFrame(data).ffill()
print('price table shape', px.shape, 'last date', px.index[-1].date())

ret = px.pct_change()
def ann_vol(w): return ret.tail(w).std()*np.sqrt(252)

print('\n=== RETURNS & VOL (thru', cut.date(), ') ===')
for s in tradable:
    c = px[s]
    r1m = c.iloc[-1]/c.iloc[-22]-1 if len(c)>22 else np.nan
    r3m = c.iloc[-1]/c.iloc[-66]-1 if len(c)>66 else np.nan
    r6m = c.iloc[-1]/c.iloc[-132]-1 if len(c)>132 else np.nan
    r12m = c.iloc[-1]/c.iloc[-252]-1 if len(c)>252 else np.nan
    v20 = ann_vol(20)[s]; v60 = ann_vol(60)[s]
    print(f'{s:10s} 1m {r1m*100:7.2f}%  3m {r3m*100:7.2f}%  6m {r6m*100:7.2f}%  12m {r12m*100:7.2f}%  vol20 {v20*100:6.1f}%  vol60 {v60*100:6.1f}%')

print('\n=== MACRO (thru', cut.date(), ') ===')
for s in macro:
    c = mdata[s]
    r1m = c.iloc[-1]/c.iloc[-22]-1 if len(c)>22 else np.nan
    r3m = c.iloc[-1]/c.iloc[-66]-1 if len(c)>66 else np.nan
    print(f'{s:8s} last {c.iloc[-1]:10.2f}  1m {r1m*100:7.2f}%  3m {r3m*100:7.2f}%')

# VIX percentile vs history since 2026
vix = mdata['VIX']
vix_hist = vix[vix.index>='2026-01-01']
print('\nVIX last', round(vix.iloc[-1],2), '90d max', round(vix.tail(90).max(),2), 'percentile vs 2026+:', round((vix.iloc[-1]<=vix_hist).mean()*100,1))

# cross-sectional dispersion (mean abs deviation of 1m returns across 15 assets)
r1m_all = {}
for s in tradable:
    c = px[s]
    r1m_all[s] = c.iloc[-1]/c.iloc[-22]-1
r = np.array(list(r1m_all.values()))
print('\nCross-section 1m: mean', round(r.mean()*100,2), 'std(dispersion)', round(r.std()*100,2), 'min', round(r.min()*100,2), 'max', round(r.max()*100,2))

# avg pairwise correlation of daily returns (60d)
rc = ret.tail(60).dropna(how='all')
corr = rc.corr()
vals = corr.values[np.triu_indices(len(corr),1)]
print('60d avg pairwise corr:', round(np.nanmean(vals),3), 'median', round(np.nanmedian(vals),3))
EOF

"""Screener cycle 2029-08-13: regime assessment + recent live IC for active factors.
Data visible window: <= 2029-08-10 (last completed trading day before decision date).
Pure factor analytics on the 15-asset cross-section; no backtest/step usage.
"""
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, glob, os, json, itertools

CUT = '2029-08-10'

# ---- load 15 tradable assets ----
files = sorted(glob.glob('../persistent/stock_data/*.csv'))
px = {}
for f in files:
    sym = os.path.basename(f).replace('.csv', '')
    df = pd.read_csv(f)
    df.columns = [c.strip().lower() for c in df.columns]
    df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
    df = df.set_index('date').sort_index()
    px[sym] = df['close'].astype(float)
px = pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index()
px = px[px.index <= CUT]
print('visible data range:', px.index.min().date(), '->', px.index.max().date(), '| rows', len(px))

# stale / frozen detection: identical closes in last 5 days
def is_stale(c):
    tail = c.iloc[-6:]
    return bool((tail.diff().dropna().abs() < 1e-12).all())
stale = [c for c in px.columns if is_stale(px[c])]
print('stale/frozen:', stale)
live = [c for c in px.columns if c not in stale]

# ---- macro observation signals ----
def load_idx(sym):
    df = pd.read_csv(f'../persistent/index_data/{sym}.csv')
    df.columns = [c.strip().lower() for c in df.columns]
    df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
    return df.set_index('date').sort_index()['close'].astype(float)

macro = {s: load_idx(s) for s in ['DXY', 'VIX', 'EURUSD', 'USDJPY', 'USDCNY']}
for s in macro:
    macro[s] = macro[s][macro[s].index <= CUT]

# ---- regime stats ----
rets = px.pct_change()
mkt = rets[live].mean(axis=1)  # equal-weight live-asset market

print('\n=== regime ===')
for w in [20, 60, 120, 252]:
    r = (1 + mkt).rolling(w).apply(np.prod, raw=True) - 1
    print(f'mkt(live) {w:3d}d cum return: {r.iloc[-1]*100:+.2f}%')

for w in [20, 60]:
    v = mkt.rolling(w).std() * np.sqrt(252)
    print(f'mkt(live) {w:3d}d realized vol (ann): {v.iloc[-1]*100:.1f}%')

cs_ret20 = (1 + rets[live]).rolling(20).apply(np.prod, raw=True) - 1
cs_disp = cs_ret20.std(axis=1)
print(f'cross-sectional dispersion of 20d returns (live): last={cs_disp.iloc[-1]*100:.2f}%  '
      f'3m mean={cs_disp.iloc[-65:].mean()*100:.2f}%  1y mean={cs_disp.iloc[-252:].mean()*100:.2f}%')

corr_vals = []
for d in rets[live].index[-60:]:
    c = rets[live].loc[d-60:d].corr()
    vals = c.values[np.triu_indices_from(c.values, k=1)]
    corr_vals.append(np.nanmean(vals))
print('avg pairwise corr (live, 60d): last=%.3f  mean_3m=%.3f' % (corr_vals[-1], np.mean(corr_vals[-65:])))

for s in ['VIX', 'DXY', 'USDJPY', 'EURUSD', 'USDCNY']:
    x = macro[s]
    print(f'{s}: last={x.iloc[-1]:.2f}  60d ago={x.iloc[-61]:.2f}' if len(x) > 61 else f'{s}: last={x.iloc[-1]:.2f}')

print('\n=== asset snapshot (21d/63d/126d ret, 20d vol ann) ===')
r21 = px.iloc[-1] / px.iloc[-22] - 1
r63 = px.iloc[-1] / px.iloc[-64] - 1
r126 = px.iloc[-1] / px.iloc[-127] - 1
vol20 = rets.iloc[-20:].std() * np.sqrt(252)
snap = pd.DataFrame({'r21': r21, 'r63': r63, 'r126': r126, 'vol20': vol20}).round(4)
print(snap.to_string())

# MA trend of equal-weight market
ma20 = mkt.rolling(20).mean()
ma60 = mkt.rolling(60).mean()
ma200 = mkt.rolling(200).mean()
print(f'\nmkt vs MA20/MA60/MA200: {mkt.iloc[-1]*100:.4f} / {ma20.iloc[-1]*100:.4f} / {ma60.iloc[-1]*100:.4f} / {ma200.iloc[-1]*100:.4f}')
print(f'mkt MA20 slope 10d: {(ma20.iloc[-1]-ma20.iloc[-11])*100:.4f}')

# individual asset MA position
print('\n=== asset MA position (last vs MA50/MA200) ===')
for a in live:
    c = px[a]
    ma50 = c.rolling(50).mean().iloc[-1]
    ma200 = c.rolling(200).mean().iloc[-1]
    last = c.iloc[-1]
    print(f'{a:10s} last={last:10.2f} vs MA50 {100*(last/ma50-1):+6.1f}%  vs MA200 {100*(last/ma200-1):+6.1f}%')

# ---- factor computation (match strategy.py) ----
print('\n=== factor recent IC (h=10 rank IC, direction-adjusted) ===')

def rolling_beta_series(y, x, win=60, min_obs=40):
    z = pd.concat([y.rename('y'), x.rename('x')], axis=1).dropna()
    out = pd.Series(index=y.index, dtype=float)
    for i in range(len(z)):
        if i < win:
            continue
        seg = z.iloc[i-win:i]
        if len(seg) < min_obs:
            continue
        var = float(seg.x.var())
        if var <= 1e-14:
            continue
        out.iloc[i] = float(seg.y.cov(seg.x) / var)
    return out

dnmkt = mkt.clip(upper=0.0)
cn10y_ret = px['CN10Y'].pct_change()

f_rates = pd.DataFrame(index=px.index, columns=px.columns, dtype=float)
f_dn = pd.DataFrame(index=px.index, columns=px.columns, dtype=float)
f_mom = pd.DataFrame(index=px.index, columns=px.columns, dtype=float)
for a in live:
    y = px[a].pct_change()
    f_rates[a] = rolling_beta_series(y, cn10y_ret, 60, 40)
    f_dn[a] = rolling_beta_series(y, dnmkt, 60, 40)
    r = px[a].pct_change()
    mom_fast = px[a] / px[a].shift(20) - 1.0
    mom_slow = px[a] / px[a].shift(60) - 1.0
    vol = r.rolling(20).std()
    f_mom[a] = (mom_fast - mom_slow) / vol

fwd = px.shift(-10) / px - 1.0

def rank_ic_series(fval, start, end, min_valid=6):
    fv = fval.loc[start:end]
    fr = fwd.loc[start:end]
    ics = []
    for d in fv.index:
        x = fv.loc[d]; y = fr.loc[d]
        m = x.notna() & y.notna()
        if m.sum() < min_valid:
            continue
        ics.append((d, x[m].rank().corr(y[m].rank())))
    if not ics:
        return pd.Series(dtype=float)
    return pd.Series(dict(ics))

fac_defs = {
    'rate_beta_cn10y_60d': (f_rates, -1),
    'dn_mkt_beta_60d': (f_dn, +1),
    'vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60': (f_mom, +1),
}

for name, (fv, direction) in fac_defs.items():
    print(f'\n--- {name} (dir {direction:+d}) ---')
    for label, win in [('63d', 63), ('126d', 126), ('252d', 252), ('756d', 756)]:
        start = px.index[-win]
        s = rank_ic_series(fv, start, CUT)
        if len(s) < 10:
            print(f'  {label}: n={len(s)} insufficient')
            continue
        ic = s.mean() * direction
        icir = ic / (s.std() / np.sqrt(len(s))) if s.std() > 0 else np.nan
        hit = (s * direction > 0).mean()
        print(f'  {label}: n={len(s):3d} adj_IC={ic:+.4f} ICIR={icir:+.3f} hit={hit*100:.0f}%')

# ---- pairwise factor IC correlation (252d) ----
print('\n=== pairwise factor IC correlation (252d) ===')
names = list(fac_defs.keys())
ic_series = {}
for name, (fv, direction) in fac_defs.items():
    s = rank_ic_series(fv, px.index[-252], CUT)
    ic_series[name] = s
for a, b in itertools.combinations(names, 2):
    sa, sb = ic_series[a].align(ic_series[b], join='inner')
    if len(sa) >= 30:
        print(f'  {a} vs {b}: corr={sa.corr(sb):+.3f} (n={len(sa)})')

# ---- current signal snapshot (last visible date) ----
print('\n=== current factor signal snapshot (last visible date = %s) ===' % px.index[-1].date())
last_date = px.index[-1]
snap_out = {}
for name, (fv, direction) in fac_defs.items():
    row = fv.loc[last_date].dropna()
    r = row.rank(pct=True)
    snap_out[name] = r
    print(f'{name}:')
    for a in r.sort_values(ascending=False).index:
        print(f'    {a:10s} val={row[a]:+.4f} rank={r[a]:.2f}')

# composite ensemble tilt (current persisted weights 0.45/-1, 0.30/+1, 0.25/+1)
print('\n=== composite ensemble tilt (persisted weights) ===')
ens = {'rate_beta_cn10y_60d': (0.45, -1), 'dn_mkt_beta_60d': (0.30, +1), 'vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60': (0.25, +1)}
comp = pd.Series(dtype=float)
for name, (w, d) in ens.items():
    comp = comp.add(snap_out[name] * d * w, fill_value=0.0)
comp = comp - 0.5 * sum(w for w, _ in ens.values())
for a in comp.sort_values(ascending=False).index:
    print(f'    {a:10s} composite={comp[a]:+.4f}')

import sys, json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
sys.path.insert(0, 'scripts')
from factor_research_lib import load_panels, close_panel, ret_panel, forward_returns, rank_ic_series, summarize_ic, library_signals

panels = load_panels(days=3000)
px = close_panel(panels)
rets = px.pct_change()
assets = px.columns.tolist()
print('assets:', len(assets), 'dates:', px.index.min().date(), '->', px.index.max().date())

mkt = rets.mean(axis=1)
dn_x = mkt.clip(upper=0.0)
def rolling_beta_fast(y, x, win, minp):
    z = pd.concat([y.rename('y'), x.rename('x')], axis=1).dropna()
    b = z['y'].rolling(win, min_periods=minp).cov(z['x']) / z['x'].rolling(win, min_periods=minp).var()
    return b

lib = {}
lib['dn_mkt_beta_60d'] = px.apply(lambda c: rolling_beta_fast(c.pct_change(), dn_x, 60, 40))
cn10y_ret = px['CN10Y'].pct_change()
lib['rate_beta_cn10y_60d'] = px.apply(lambda c: rolling_beta_fast(c.pct_change(), cn10y_ret, 60, 40))
def vol_adj_mom_accel(c, fast=20, slow=60, vol_win=20):
    r = c.pct_change()
    return (c / c.shift(fast) - 1.0 - (c / c.shift(slow) - 1.0)) / r.rolling(vol_win).std()
lib['vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60'] = px.apply(vol_adj_mom_accel)

fwd = forward_returns(rets, 10)
for name, sig in lib.items():
    ic = rank_ic_series(sig, fwd)
    ic = ic.dropna()
    last_date = ic.index.max()
    print('='*70)
    print(name, '| n_ic_dates:', len(ic), '| last IC date:', last_date.date())
    for win, label in [(252,'1y'), (130,'130d'), (63,'~3m'), (21,'~1m')]:
        sub = ic.tail(win)
        if len(sub) > 5:
            m = sub.mean(); sd = sub.std()
            print(f'  {label}: IC={m:+.4f} ICIR={m/max(sd,1e-9):+.3f} hit={(sub>0).mean():.2f}')
" 2>&1 | tail -40

python -c "
import sys
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
sys.path.insert(0, 'scripts')
from factor_research_lib import load_panels, close_panel

panels = load_panels(days=3000)
px = close_panel(panels)
rets = px.pct_change()

mkt = rets.mean(axis=1)
dn_x = mkt.clip(upper=0.0)
def rolling_beta_fast(y, x, win, minp):
    z = pd.concat([y.rename('y'), x.rename('x')], axis=1).dropna()
    b = z['y'].rolling(win, min_periods=minp).cov(z['x']) / z['x'].rolling(win, min_periods=minp).var()
    return b

sig = {}
sig['dn_mkt_beta_60d'] = px.apply(lambda c: rolling_beta_fast(c.pct_change(), dn_x, 60, 40))
sig['rate_beta_cn10y_60d'] = px.apply(lambda c: rolling_beta_fast(c.pct_change(), px['CN10Y'].pct_change(), 60, 40))
def vol_adj_mom_accel(c, fast=20, slow=60, vol_win=20):
    r = c.pct_change()
    return (c / c.shift(fast) - 1.0 - (c / c.shift(slow) - 1.0)) / r.rolling(vol_win).std()
sig['vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60'] = px.apply(vol_adj_mom_accel)

# daily cross-sectional rank correlation between factors (last 130d)
names = list(sig.keys())
corrs = []
for i in range(len(names)):
    for j in range(i+1, len(names)):
        a, b = names[i], names[j]
        rs = []
        for dt in sig[a].index[-130:]:
            ra = sig[a].loc[dt].rank(); rb = sig[b].loc[dt].rank()
            if ra.nunique() > 3 and rb.nunique() > 3:
                rs.append(ra.corr(rb))
        rs = [r for r in rs if not np.isnan(r)]
        corrs.append((a, b, round(float(np.mean(rs)), 3), len(rs)))
for c in corrs:
    print(c)
