import pandas as pd, numpy as np, glob, os
cutoff = '2032-11-12'
assets = ['000300.SH','000688.SH','BTC','CN10Y','COPPER','ETH','HSI','N225','NDX','SOX','SPX','SX5E','US10Y','WTI','XAU']
closes = {}
for a in assets:
    df = pd.read_csv(f'../persistent/stock_data/{a}.csv')
    df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
    df = df[df['date'] <= cutoff].set_index('date')['close']
    closes[a] = df
px = pd.DataFrame(closes).sort_index()
ret = px.pct_change()
print('last date:', px.index[-1].date(), 'rows:', len(px))
print()
print('=== 10d / 20d / 60d returns through 2032-11-12 ===')
for a in assets:
    r10 = px[a].iloc[-1]/px[a].iloc[-11]-1 if len(px)>=11 else np.nan
    r20 = px[a].iloc[-1]/px[a].iloc[-21]-1 if len(px)>=21 else np.nan
    r60 = px[a].iloc[-1]/px[a].iloc[-61]-1 if len(px)>=61 else np.nan
    vol20 = ret[a].iloc[-20:].std()*np.sqrt(252) if len(ret)>=20 else np.nan
    print(f'{a:12s} r10={r10*100:7.2f}%  r20={r20*100:7.2f}%  r60={r60*100:7.2f}%  vol20={vol20*100:5.1f}%')
print()
print('=== equal-weight market ===')

files = ['000300.SH','000688.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']

"""Screener (2033-01-10): re-validate the 3 active factors through 2033-01-07 and measure recent block IC."""
import pandas as pd, numpy as np

VD = '2033-01-07'
ASSETS = ['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']

def load(sym):
    df = pd.read_csv(f'../persistent/stock_data/{sym}.csv')
    df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
    df = df[df['date'] <= VD].sort_values('date').reset_index(drop=True)
    return df.set_index('date')['close']

px = pd.DataFrame({s: load(s) for s in ASSETS}).ffill()
rets = px.pct_change()
print(f"px range {px.index.min().date()} -> {px.index.max().date()} rows={len(px)}")

# --- factor 1: vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60 ---
vol20 = rets.rolling(20).std()
mom20 = px / px.shift(20) - 1
mom60 = px / px.shift(60) - 1
f1 = (mom20 - mom60) / vol20

# --- factor 2: dn_mkt_beta_60d ---
mkt = rets.mean(axis=1)
dn = mkt.where(mkt < 0, 0.0)

def roll_beta_df(y_df, x, w=60, min_obs=40):
    cols = y_df.columns
    out = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=y_df.index, columns=cols)
    arr_y = y_df.values; arr_x = x.values
    n = len(y_df)
    for i in range(w, n):
        seg_x = arr_x[i-w:i]
        base = ~np.isnan(seg_x)
        if base.sum() < min_obs:
            continue
        for j, c in enumerate(cols):
            seg_y = arr_y[i-w:i, j]
            mm = base & ~np.isnan(seg_y)
            if mm.sum() < min_obs:
                continue
            a, b = np.polyfit(seg_x[mm], seg_y[mm], 1)
            out.iloc[i, j] = b
    return out

f2 = roll_beta_df(rets, dn)

# --- factor 3: rate_beta_cn10y_60d ---
cn10y = px['CN10Y'].pct_change()
f3 = roll_beta_df(rets, cn10y)

# forward 10d returns
fwd10 = px.shift(-10) / px - 1

def rank_ic(f, y, min_valid=8):
    out = {}
    for dt in f.index:
        xv = f.loc[dt]; yv = y.loc[dt]
        m = xv.notna() & yv.notna()
        if m.sum() >= min_valid:
            out[dt] = np.corrcoef(xv[m].rank(), yv[m].rank())[0,1]
    return pd.Series(out)

ic1 = rank_ic(f1, fwd10); ic2 = rank_ic(f2, fwd10); ic3 = rank_ic(f3, fwd10)

print('\n=== RECENT FACTOR IC (rank IC vs fwd 10d, universe>=8 valid) ===')
for name, ic in [('vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60', ic1), ('dn_mkt_beta_60d', ic2), ('rate_beta_cn10y_60d', ic3)]:
    full = ic.dropna()
    r1 = full[full.index >= '2032-01-01']
    r2 = full[full.index >= '2032-07-01']
    r3 = full[full.index >= '2032-10-01']
    def stat(s):
        if len(s) == 0: return 'n/a'
        return f"n={len(s)} mean={s.mean():+.3f} icir={s.mean()/s.std():+.2f} hit={(s>0).mean():.2f}"
    print(f'{name} | full: {stat(full)}')
    print(f'   since 2032-01: {stat(r1)}')
    print(f'   since 2032-07: {stat(r2)}')
    print(f'   since 2032-10: {stat(r3)}')

print('\n=== LATEST FACTOR EXPOSURES (2033-01-07) ===')
for name, f in [('vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60', f1), ('dn_mkt_beta_60d', f2), ('rate_beta_cn10y_60d', f3)]:
    row = f.iloc[-1]
    print(name)
    print('  top5:', [(a, round(row[a],4)) for a in row.sort_values(ascending=False).index[:5]])
    print('  bot5:', [(a, round(row[a],4)) for a in row.sort_values(ascending=False).index[-5:]])

print('\n=== LATEST EXPOSURE PAIRWISE CORR ===')
stack = pd.concat([f1.iloc[-1].rename('f1'), f2.iloc[-1].rename('f2'), f3.iloc[-1].rename('f3')], axis=1)
print(stack.corr().round(3))

python << 'EOF'
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, glob, os

CUTOFF = '2033-02-06'  # last completed trading day before current date 2033-02-07

assets = ['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
px = {}
for a in assets:
    df = pd.read_csv(f'../persistent/stock_data/{a}.csv')
    df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
    df = df[df['date'] <= CUTOFF].set_index('date').sort_index()
    px[a] = df['close']

p = pd.DataFrame(px)
rets = p.pct_change()

# recent returns
print("=== Recent returns (last completed day:", p.index[-1].date(), ") ===")
print("20d rets:")
print((p.iloc[-1]/p.iloc[-21]-1).sort_values().round(4).to_string())
print("\n60d rets:")
print((p.iloc[-1]/p.iloc[-61]-1).sort_values().round(4).to_string())
print("\n120d rets:")
print((p.iloc[-1]/p.iloc[-121]-1).sort_values().round(4).to_string())

# trend: price vs MA60, MA slope
ma60 = p.rolling(60).mean()
ma20 = p.rolling(20).mean()
above_ma60 = (p.iloc[-1] > ma60.iloc[-1]).mean()
above_ma20 = (p.iloc[-1] > ma20.iloc[-1]).mean()
print(f"\nBreadth: fraction above MA60 = {above_ma60:.2f}, above MA20 = {above_ma20:.2f}")

# vol
vol20 = rets.tail(20).std()*np.sqrt(252)
vol60 = rets.tail(60).std()*np.sqrt(252)
print("\nAnnualized vol 20d / 60d:")
print(pd.DataFrame({'vol20':vol20.round(3),'vol60':vol60.round(3)}).to_string())

# equal-weight index trend
ew = p.mean(axis=1)
ew_ret20 = ew.iloc[-1]/ew.iloc[-21]-1
ew_ret60 = ew.iloc[-1]/ew.iloc[-61]-1
ew_ret120 = ew.iloc[-1]/ew.iloc[-121]-1
ew_vol = rets.mean(axis=1).tail(60).std()*np.sqrt(252)
print(f"\nEW index: 20d {ew_ret20:.4f}, 60d {ew_ret60:.4f}, 120d {ew_ret120:.4f}, 60d vol {ew_vol:.4f}")

# drawdown of EW index
cum = (1+rets.mean(axis=1)).cumprod()
dd = cum/cum.cummax()-1
print(f"EW index max drawdown last 120d: {dd.tail(120).min():.4f}, last 60d: {dd.tail(60).min():.4f}")

# cross-asset correlation (avg pairwise corr of 60d returns)
c60 = rets.tail(60).corr()
tri = c60.values[np.triu_indices(15,1)]
print(f"\nAvg pairwise 60d corr: {np.nanmean(tri):.3f}, median {np.nanmedian(tri):.3f}")

# VIX
vix = pd.read_csv('../persistent/index_data/VIX.csv')
vix['date'] = pd.to_datetime(vix['date'])
vix = vix[vix['date'] <= CUTOFF].set_index('date').sort_index()
print(f"\nVIX last: {vix['close'].iloc[-1]:.2f}, 20d ago: {vix['close'].iloc[-21]:.2f}, 60d mean: {vix['close'].tail(60).mean():.2f}")
EOF

    df = df[df[dc] <= pd.Timestamp(ASOF)].reset_index(drop=True)
    cc = 'close' if 'close' in df.columns else 'Close'

    vol20 = df['ret'].tail(20).std()*np.sqrt(252)
    vol60 = df['ret'].tail(60).std()*np.sqrt(252)
    ma20 = px.tail(20).mean(); ma60 = px.tail(60).mean()
    # max drawdown over last 120d
    w = px.tail(120)
    dd = (w/w.cummax()-1).min()
    rows.append({'asset':a,'last':round(last,2),'r5':round(r(5)*100,2),'r20':round(r(20)*100,2),

import json, base64, zlib, io
import pandas as pd, numpy as np

def load_panel(fid):
    d = json.load(open(f'factors/{fid}.json'))
    sa = d['validation']['signal_artifact']
    fmt = sa['format']
    cols = sa['columns']
    if fmt == 'base64:zlib:csv':
        raw = base64.b64decode(sa['data'])
        csv = zlib.decompress(raw).decode()
        df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(csv))
        df.columns = [c.strip() for c in df.columns]
        return df
    elif fmt == 'panel_json_v1':
        dates = sa['dates']; data = sa['data']
        arr = np.array(data)
        df = pd.DataFrame(arr, columns=cols)
        df.insert(0, 'date', dates)
        return df
    else:
        print('unknown fmt', fmt); return None

ASOF = '2033-03-04'
for fid in ['vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60','dn_mkt_beta_60d','rate_beta_cn10y_60d']:
    df = load_panel(fid)
    df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
    sub = df[df['date'] <= pd.Timestamp(ASOF)]
    print('===', fid, 'rows:', len(sub), 'last date:', sub['date'].max().date())
    last = sub.iloc[-1]
    print('last row values:')
    for c in last.index:
        if c != 'date':
            print(f'  {c}: {float(last[c]):+.4f}')
    print()
EOF

"""Screener regime & factor check - uses only data visible through 2033-03-18."""
import json, glob, os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

DATA = "../persistent/stock_data"
IDX = "../persistent/index_data"
ASSETS = ["000300.SH","SPX","HSI","N225","SX5E","000688.SH","SOX","NDX","XAU",
          "COPPER","WTI","BTC","ETH","US10Y","CN10Y"]
OBS = ["DXY","USDCNY","USDJPY","EURUSD","VIX"]

def load_close(sym, d=DATA):
    p = os.path.join(d, sym + ".csv")
    df = pd.read_csv(p, parse_dates=["date"]).set_index("date")
    return df["close"].astype(float)

closes = pd.DataFrame({s: load_close(s) for s in ASSETS})
obs = pd.DataFrame({s: load_close(s, d=IDX) for s in OBS})

last_date = closes.index.max()
print("last close date:", last_date.date())
print("last obs date:", obs.index.max().date())

rets = closes.pct_change()
obs_rets = obs.pct_change()

# --- Regime stats as of last date ---
def stat(name, series):
    v = series.iloc[-1]
    return f"{name}: {v:+.2%}" if abs(v) < 1 else f"{name}: {v:+.1f}"

print("\n=== CROSS-SECTION (15 assets) ===")
cs = pd.DataFrame({
    "ret_1d": rets.iloc[-1],
    "ret_5d": closes.pct_change(5).iloc[-1],
    "ret_10d": closes.pct_change(10).iloc[-1],
    "ret_20d": closes.pct_change(20).iloc[-1],
    "ret_60d": closes.pct_change(60).iloc[-1],
    "ret_120d": closes.pct_change(120).iloc[-1],
    "vol20": rets.tail(20).std() * np.sqrt(252),
})
print(cs.round(4).to_string())

print("\n=== CROSS-SECTIONAL SUMMARY ===")
for col in ["ret_5d","ret_10d","ret_20d","ret_60d","ret_120d"]:
    v = cs[col]
    print(f"{col}: mean {v.mean():+.2%}  median {v.median():+.2%}  std {v.std():.2%}  "
          f"min {v.min():+.2%}  max {v.max():+.2%}")

print("\n=== OBSERVATION SIGNALS (macro) ===")
for s in OBS:
    o = obs_rets[s]
    print(f"{s}: last {o.iloc[-1]:+.2%} | 5d {o.tail(5).sum():+.2%} | 20d {o.tail(20).sum():+.2%} | "
          f"60d {o.tail(60).sum():+.2%} | level {obs[s].iloc[-1]:.2f}")

print("\n=== MARKET TREND / RISK ===")
ew = closes.mean(axis=1)  # equal-weight cross-asset market proxy
ew_ret = ew.pct_change()
ma20 = ew.rolling(20).mean()
ma60 = ew.rolling(60).mean()
print(f"EW market: 20d ret {ew_ret.tail(20).sum():+.2%}  60d ret {ew_ret.tail(60).sum():+.2%}  120d {ew_ret.tail(120).sum():+.2%}")
print(f"EW vs MA20: {'above' if ew.iloc[-1] > ma20.iloc[-1] else 'below'}; MA20 slope 10d: {(ma20.iloc[-1]/ma20.iloc[-11]-1):+.2%}")
print(f"EW vs MA60: {'above' if ew.iloc[-1] > ma60.iloc[-1] else 'below'}")
realvol = ew_ret.tail(20).std() * np.sqrt(252)
print(f"EW 20d realized vol (ann): {realvol:.2%}")

# cross-sectional dispersion of 20d returns
disp = cs["ret_20d"].std()
print(f"Cross-sectional dispersion 20d: {disp:.2%}")

# avg pairwise correlation of 20d returns
c = rets.tail(20).corr()
avg_corr = (c.values[np.triu_indices_from(c.values, k=1)]).mean()
print(f"Avg pairwise 20d correlation (15 assets): {avg_corr:.3f}")

# count up/down last 10d
ups = (rets.tail(10) > 0).sum().sum()
print(f"Up days (asset-day) last 10d: {ups}/{15*10}")

# VIX level & 20d change
print(f"\nVIX level {obs['VIX'].iloc[-1]:.1f} (60d ago {obs['VIX'].iloc[-61]:.1f})")

# --- Factor signals: recent IC (h=10) ---
print("\n=== ACTIVE FACTOR RECENT IC (h=10 forward, cross-sectional) ===")
for fp in sorted(glob.glob("factors/*.json")):
    if "ensemble" in fp or fp.endswith(".bak"):
        continue
    d = json.load(open(fp))
    fid = d["factor_id"]
    # panel json: dates x assets
    sig = d.get("signal_artifact", {})
    if sig.get("format") != "panel_json_v1":
        print(fid, "skip non-panel", sig.get("format")); continue
    sdates = sig["dates"]
    mat = np.array(sig["matrix"]) if "matrix" in sig else None
    if mat is None:
        # maybe values key
        vals = sig.get("values")
        if vals is not None:
            mat = np.array(vals)
    if mat is None:
        print(fid, "no matrix"); continue
    S = pd.DataFrame(mat, index=pd.to_datetime(sdates), columns=ASSETS)
    S = S.reindex(closes.index).ffill()
    fwd = closes.shift(-10) / closes - 1
    common = S.index.intersection(fwd.index)
    S, F = S.loc[common], fwd.loc[common]
    ic_series = []
    for t in range(len(common)):
        srow, frow = S.iloc[t], F.iloc[t]
        m = srow.notna() & frow.notna()
        if m.sum() >= 8:
            ic_series.append(np.corrcoef(srow[m], frow[m])[0, 1])
    ic = pd.Series(ic_series, index=common)
    for w in [20, 60, 120]:
        if len(ic) >= w:
            sub = ic.tail(w)
            print(f"{fid}: IC_{w}d {sub.mean():+.3f} (std {sub.std():.3f}, ICIR {sub.mean()/sub.std():+.3f}, hit { (sub>0).mean():.0%}, n={len(sub)})")
        else:
            print(f"{fid}: only {len(ic)} dates")

"""Regime + factor recent-IC check using ONLY data visible through 2033-03-18."""
import json, os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

CUTOFF = pd.Timestamp("2033-03-18")
DATA = "../persistent/stock_data"
IDX = "../persistent/index_data"
ASSETS = ["000300.SH","SPX","HSI","N225","SX5E","000688.SH","SOX","NDX","XAU",
          "COPPER","WTI","BTC","ETH","US10Y","CN10Y"]
OBS = ["DXY","USDCNY","USDJPY","EURUSD","VIX"]

def load_close(sym, d=DATA):
    df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(d, sym + ".csv"), parse_dates=["date"]).set_index("date")
    return df["close"].astype(float)

closes = pd.DataFrame({s: load_close(s) for s in ASSETS})
closes = closes.loc[:CUTOFF]
obs = pd.DataFrame({s: load_close(s, d=IDX) for s in OBS}).loc[:CUTOFF]
rets = closes.pct_change()
obs_rets = obs.pct_change()

print("visible data range:", closes.index.min().date(), "->", closes.index.max().date())
print("\nAssets with valid close at cutoff (non-NaN, non-flat):")
for s in ASSETS:
    v = closes[s]
    nz = (v.diff().dropna() != 0).sum()
    print(f"  {s:10s} last={v.iloc[-1]:12.4f}  nonflat_days={nz}")

print("\n=== CROSS-SECTION as of", CUTOFF.date(), "===")
cs = pd.DataFrame({
    "ret_5d": closes.pct_change(5).iloc[-1],
    "ret_10d": closes.pct_change(10).iloc[-1],
    "ret_20d": closes.pct_change(20).iloc[-1],
    "ret_60d": closes.pct_change(60).iloc[-1],
    "vol20": rets.tail(20).std() * np.sqrt(252),
})
print(cs.round(4).to_string())

print("\n=== SUMMARY ===")
for col in ["ret_5d","ret_10d","ret_20d","ret_60d"]:
    v = cs[col]
    print(f"{col}: mean {v.mean():+.2%} median {v.median():+.2%} std {v.std():.2%} min {v.min():+.2%} max {v.max():+.2%}")

print("\n=== MACRO OBS ===")
for s in OBS:
    o = obs_rets[s]
    print(f"{s}: 1d {o.iloc[-1]:+.2%} 5d {o.tail(5).sum():+.2%} 20d {o.tail(20).sum():+.2%} "
          f"60d {o.tail(60).sum():+.2%} level {obs[s].iloc[-1]:.2f}")

ew = closes.mean(axis=1)
ew_ret = ew.pct_change()
print("\n=== TREND/RISK ===")
print(f"EW market 20d {ew_ret.tail(20).sum():+.2%} 60d {ew_ret.tail(60).sum():+.2%} 120d {ew_ret.tail(120).sum():+.2%}")
ma20 = ew.rolling(20).mean(); ma60 = ew.rolling(60).mean()
print(f"EW {'above' if ew.iloc[-1]>ma20.iloc[-1] else 'below'} MA20 | {'above' if ew.iloc[-1]>ma60.iloc[-1] else 'below'} MA60")
print(f"EW 20d realized vol ann: {ew_ret.tail(20).std()*np.sqrt(252):.2%}")
print(f"Cross-sectional 20d dispersion: {cs['ret_20d'].std():.2%}")
c = rets.tail(20).corr()
vals = c.values[np.triu_indices_from(c.values, k=1)]
vals = vals[~np.isnan(vals)]
print(f"Avg pairwise 20d corr: {vals.mean():.3f}")
print(f"VIX: {obs['VIX'].iloc[-1]:.1f} | 20d ago {obs['VIX'].iloc[-21]:.1f} | 60d ago {obs['VIX'].iloc[-61]:.1f}")

# ---------------- factor recomputation ----------------
print("\n=== FACTOR RECENT IC (h=10), recomputed on visible data ===")
H = 10
fwd = closes.shift(-H) / closes - 1

mkt = closes.mean(axis=1)
mkt_ret = mkt.pct_change()

# factor 1: vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60
mom20 = closes / closes.shift(20) - 1
mom60 = closes / closes.shift(60) - 1
vol20 = rets.rolling(20).std()
f_mom = (mom20 - mom60) / vol20

# factor 2: dn_mkt_beta_60d
down = mkt_ret.clip(upper=0)
f_beta = pd.DataFrame(index=closes.index, columns=ASSETS, dtype=float)
for s in ASSETS:
    x = pd.concat([rets[s], down], axis=1).dropna()
    cov = x[s].rolling(60).cov(x[0]) if False else None
    # rolling beta via rolling cov/var
    rc = rets[s].rolling(60).cov(down)
    rv = down.rolling(60).var()
    f_beta[s] = rc / rv

# factor 3: rate_beta_cn10y_60d
cn10y_chg = closes["CN10Y"].pct_change()
f_rate = pd.DataFrame(index=closes.index, columns=ASSETS, dtype=float)
for s in ASSETS:
    rc = rets[s].rolling(60).cov(cn10y_chg)
    rv = cn10y_chg.rolling(60).var()
    f_rate[s] = rc / rv

def recent_ic(fac, name, direction):
    ic = []
    dates = fac.index.intersection(fwd.index)
    for t in dates:
        srow, frow = fac.loc[t], fwd.loc[t]
        m = srow.notna() & frow.notna() & np.isfinite(srow) & np.isfinite(frow)
        if m.sum() >= 8:
            ic.append(np.corrcoef(srow[m], frow[m])[0, 1])
    ic = pd.Series(ic, index=dates)
    out = {}
    for w in [20, 60, 120]:
        sub = ic.tail(w)
        if len(sub) >= 10:
            out[w] = (sub.mean(), sub.mean()/sub.std(), (sub>0).mean(), len(sub))
    print(f"{name} (dir {direction:+d}): " + " | ".join(
        f"IC{w}d={v[0]:+.3f} ICIR={v[1]:+.3f} hit={v[2]:.0%} n={v[3]}" for w, v in out.items()))
    return ic

ic_mom = recent_ic(f_mom, "vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60", 1)
ic_beta = recent_ic(f_beta, "dn_mkt_beta_60d", 1)
ic_rate = recent_ic(f_rate, "rate_beta_cn10y_60d", -1)

print("\n=== FACTOR PAIRWISE CORR (cross-sectional, last 120d avg) ===")
last120 = closes.index[-120:]
for a, b in [("mom","beta"),("mom","rate"),("beta","rate")]:
    fa, fb = {"mom": f_mom, "beta": f_beta, "rate": f_rate}[a], {"mom": f_mom, "beta": f_beta, "rate": f_rate}[b]
    cs_corrs = []
    for t in last120:
        x, y = fa.loc[t], fb.loc[t]
        m = x.notna() & y.notna() & np.isfinite(x) & np.isfinite(y)
        if m.sum() >= 8:
            cs_corrs.append(np.corrcoef(x[m], y[m])[0, 1])

"""Regime + factor recent-IC check using ONLY data visible through 2033-03-18 (fixed)."""
import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

CUTOFF = pd.Timestamp("2033-03-18")
DATA = "../persistent/stock_data"
IDX = "../persistent/index_data"
ASSETS = ["000300.SH","SPX","HSI","N225","SX5E","000688.SH","SOX","NDX","XAU",
          "COPPER","WTI","BTC","ETH","US10Y","CN10Y"]
OBS = ["DXY","USDCNY","USDJPY","EURUSD","VIX"]

def load_close(sym, d=DATA):
    df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(d, sym + ".csv"), parse_dates=["date"]).set_index("date")
    return df["close"].astype(float)

closes = pd.DataFrame({s: load_close(s) for s in ASSETS}).loc[:CUTOFF]
obs = pd.DataFrame({s: load_close(s, d=IDX) for s in OBS}).loc[:CUTOFF]
rets = closes.pct_change()
obs_rets = obs.pct_change()

H = 10
fwd = closes.shift(-H) / closes - 1
mkt = closes.mean(axis=1)
mkt_ret = mkt.pct_change()

# factor 1: vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60
mom20 = closes / closes.shift(20) - 1
mom60 = closes / closes.shift(60) - 1
vol20 = rets.rolling(20).std()
f_mom = (mom20 - mom60) / vol20

# factor 2: dn_mkt_beta_60d (beta on down-market days)
down = mkt_ret.clip(upper=0)
f_beta = pd.DataFrame(index=closes.index, columns=ASSETS, dtype=float)
for s in ASSETS:
    f_beta[s] = rets[s].rolling(60).cov(down) / down.rolling(60).var()

# factor 3: rate_beta_cn10y_60d (beta on CN10Y yield change)
cn10y_chg = closes["CN10Y"].pct_change()
f_rate = pd.DataFrame(index=closes.index, columns=ASSETS, dtype=float)
for s in ASSETS:
    f_rate[s] = rets[s].rolling(60).cov(cn10y_chg) / cn10y_chg.rolling(60).var()

def recent_ic(fac, name, direction):
    pairs = []
    for t in fac.index:
        if t not in fwd.index:
            continue
        srow, frow = fac.loc[t], fwd.loc[t]
        m = srow.notna() & frow.notna() & np.isfinite(srow.astype(float)) & np.isfinite(frow.astype(float))
        if m.sum() >= 8:
            pairs.append((t, np.corrcoef(srow[m].astype(float), frow[m].astype(float))[0, 1]))
    if not pairs:
        print(f"{name}: no dates"); return pd.Series(dtype=float)
    idx, vals = zip(*pairs)
    ic = pd.Series(vals, index=pd.DatetimeIndex(idx))
    out = {}
    for w in [20, 60, 120, 250]:
        sub = ic.tail(w)
        if len(sub) >= 10:
            out[w] = (sub.mean(), sub.mean()/sub.std(), (sub>0).mean(), len(sub))
    print(f"{name} (dir {direction:+d}): " + " | ".join(
        f"IC{w}d={v[0]:+.3f} ICIR={v[1]:+.3f} hit={v[2]:.0%} n={v[3]}" for w, v in out.items()))
    return ic

ic_mom = recent_ic(f_mom, "vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60", 1)
ic_beta = recent_ic(f_beta, "dn_mkt_beta_60d", 1)
ic_rate = recent_ic(f_rate, "rate_beta_cn10y_60d", -1)

print("\n=== FACTOR PAIRWISE CS-CORR (last 120d avg) ===")
last120 = closes.index[-120:]
for a, b in [("mom","beta"),("mom","rate"),("beta","rate")]:
    fa, fb = {"mom": f_mom, "beta": f_beta, "rate": f_rate}[a], {"mom": f_mom, "beta": f_beta, "rate": f_rate}[b]
    cs_corrs = []
    for t in last120:
        x, y = fa.loc[t].astype(float), fb.loc[t].astype(float)
        m = x.notna() & y.notna() & np.isfinite(x) & np.isfinite(y)
        if m.sum() >= 8:
            cs_corrs.append(np.corrcoef(x[m], y[m])[0, 1])
    print(f"{a}-{b}: mean cs-corr {np.nanmean(cs_corrs):+.3f} (n={len(cs_corrs)})")

print("\n=== LATEST CROSS-SECTIONAL SIGNAL RANKS (2033-03-18) ===")
for name, fac, direction in [("vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60", f_mom, 1),
                              ("dn_mkt_beta_60d", f_beta, 1),
                              ("rate_beta_cn10y_60d", f_rate, -1)]:
    row = fac.iloc[-1].astype(float)
    eff = row * direction
    ranked = eff.dropna().rank(ascending=False)
    print(f"{name} (dir{direction:+d}): " + ", ".join(f"{s}={eff[s]:+.3f}(r{ranked[s]:.0f})" for s in ASSETS if np.isfinite(eff[s])))

python - <<'EOF'
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, os

assets = ['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
base = '../persistent/stock_data'
rows=[]
for a in assets:
    p = os.path.join(base, a+'.csv')
    df = pd.read_csv(p)
    df.columns = [c.strip() for c in df.columns]
    datecol = 'date' if 'date' in df.columns else df.columns[0]
    df[datecol] = pd.to_datetime(df[datecol])
    df = df.sort_values(datecol).reset_index(drop=True)
    close = df['close'].astype(float)
    # use only rows with valid close
    df = df[close.notna()].reset_index(drop=True)
    c = df['close'].astype(float)
    ret = c.pct_change()
    last = c.iloc[-1]
    # trend stats
    def ret_over(n):
        return c.iloc[-1]/c.iloc[-1-n]-1 if len(c)>n else np.nan
    r20, r60, r120 = ret_over(20), ret_over(60), ret_over(120)
    vol20 = ret.iloc[-20:].std()*np.sqrt(252)
    ma20 = c.iloc[-20:].mean(); ma60 = c.iloc[-60:].mean() if len(c)>=60 else np.nan
    trend = 'UP' if ma20>ma60 else 'DOWN'
    rows.append([a, round(last,2), round(r20*100,2), round(r60*100,2), round(r120*100,2), round(vol20*100,1), trend, len(df), str(df[datecol].iloc[-1].date())])
out = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=['asset','last','r20%','r60%','r120%','vol20%','MA20vMA60','n','last_date'])
print(out.to_string(index=False))
EOF

for r in res:
    print(' | '.join(r))

"""Screener regime assessment - data through 2033-06-24 (last completed trading day visible)."""
import pandas as pd, numpy as np

ASSETS = ['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
END = '2033-06-24'

px = {}
for s in ASSETS:
    df = pd.read_csv(f'../persistent/stock_data/{s}.csv')
    df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
    df = df[df['date'] <= END].set_index('date').sort_index()
    px[s] = df['close']

PX = pd.DataFrame(px).dropna(how='all')
PX = PX.ffill()
print('Rows through', END, ':', len(PX))

ret = PX.pct_change()

def ann_vol(r, win=20):
    return r.rolling(win).std() * np.sqrt(252)

def maxdd(px, win=60):
    return (px / px.rolling(win, min_periods=1).max() - 1).min()

rows = {}
for s in ASSETS:
    p = PX[s]
    r = ret[s]
    rows[s] = {
        'close': p.iloc[-1],
        'ret_10d': p.iloc[-1]/p.iloc[-11]-1 if len(p) > 11 else np.nan,
        'ret_20d': p.iloc[-1]/p.iloc[-21]-1 if len(p) > 21 else np.nan,
        'ret_60d': p.iloc[-1]/p.iloc[-61]-1 if len(p) > 61 else np.nan,
        'ret_120d': p.iloc[-1]/p.iloc[-121]-1 if len(p) > 121 else np.nan,
        'ma20': p.rolling(20).mean().iloc[-1],
        'ma60': p.rolling(60).mean().iloc[-1],
        'ma20_slope_10d': (p.rolling(20).mean().iloc[-1] / p.rolling(20).mean().iloc[-11] - 1) if len(p) > 30 else np.nan,
        'vol20_ann': ann_vol(r).iloc[-1],
        'vol60_ann': ann_vol(r, 60).iloc[-1],
        'maxdd60': maxdd(p, 60),
        'maxdd120': maxdd(p, 120),
        'above_ma20': p.iloc[-1] > p.rolling(20).mean().iloc[-1],
        'above_ma60': p.iloc[-1] > p.rolling(60).mean().iloc[-1],
    }

R = pd.DataFrame(rows).T
print('\n=== Per-asset snapshot (through 2033-06-24) ===')
print(R[['ret_10d','ret_20d','ret_60d','ret_120d','vol20_ann','maxdd60','above_ma20','above_ma60']].round(4).to_string())

print('\n=== Cross-sectional stats (ret_20d / ret_60d) ===')
for col in ['ret_10d','ret_20d','ret_60d','ret_120d']:
    v = R[col].dropna()
    print(f'{col}: mean={v.mean():.4f} std={v.std():.4f} min={v.min():.4f} max={v.max():.4f} spread={v.max()-v.min():.4f}')

print('\n=== MA20/MA60 alignment ===')
print((R['above_ma20'] & R['above_ma60']).sum(), 'assets above both MAs;',
      (~R['above_ma20'] & ~R['above_ma60']).sum(), 'assets below both')

print('\n=== Macro observation-only (through 2033-06-24) ===')
for m in ['VIX','DXY','EURUSD','USDJPY','USDCNY']:
    df = pd.read_csv(f'../persistent/index_data/{m}.csv')
    df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
    df = df[df['date'] <= END].set_index('date').sort_index()
    c = df['close']
    print(f"{m}: last={c.iloc[-1]:.3f} ret_10d={c.iloc[-1]/c.iloc[-11]-1:+.3%} ret_20d={c.iloc[-1]/c.iloc[-21]-1:+.3%} ret_60d={c.iloc[-1]/c.iloc[-61]-1:+.3%} vol20={c.pct_change().rolling(20).std().iloc[-1]*np.sqrt(252):.2%}")

# Equal-weight basket regime
basket = PX.mean(axis=1)
bret = basket.pct_change()
print(f'\n=== Equal-weight basket ===')
print(f'basket ret_20d={basket.iloc[-1]/basket.iloc[-21]-1:+.3%} ret_60d={basket.iloc[-1]/basket.iloc[-61]-1:+.3%} vol20={bret.rolling(20).std().iloc[-1]*np.sqrt(252):.2%}')
print(f'basket maxdd60={(basket/basket.rolling(60).max()-1).min():.2%}')

# pairwise correlation regime (20d rolling)
c20 = ret.iloc[-21:].corr()
print(f'\n=== 20d pairwise corr === mean={c20.values[np.triu_indices_from(c20.values,1)].mean():.2f} max={c20.values[np.triu_indices_from(c20.values,1)].max():.2f}')
c60 = ret.iloc[-61:].corr()
print(f'60d pairwise corr mean={c60.values[np.triu_indices_from(c60.values,1)].mean():.2f} max={c60.values[np.triu_indices_from(c60.values,1)].max():.2f}')

python -c "
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, glob, os
cutoff = pd.Timestamp('2033-07-08')
assets = ['000300.SH','000688.SH','BTC','CN10Y','COPPER','ETH','HSI','N225','NDX','SOX','SPX','SX5E','US10Y','WTI','XAU']
prices = {}
for a in assets:
    df = pd.read_csv(f'../persistent/stock_data/{a}.csv')
    df.columns = [c.strip() for c in df.columns]
    dc = 'date' if 'date' in df.columns else df.columns[0]
    df[dc] = pd.to_datetime(df[dc])
    df = df[df[dc] <= cutoff].set_index(dc).sort_index()
    cc = 'close' if 'close' in df.columns else df.columns[4]
    prices[a] = df[cc].astype(float)
px = pd.DataFrame(prices)
rets = px.pct_change()

# Factor 1: vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60
mom20 = px/px.shift(20) - 1
mom60 = px/px.shift(60) - 1
vol20 = rets.rolling(20).std()
f1 = (mom20 - mom60)/vol20

# Factor 2: dn_mkt_beta_60d (downside beta: covariance with market on downside days)
# approximate: beta of asset returns on days when market return < 0, rolling 60d
mkt = px.mean(axis=1).pct_change()  # simple equal-weight market proxy
down = rets[mkt < 0]
# rolling downside beta via cov/var
def roll_down_beta(r, m, w=60):
    out = pd.Series(np.nan, index=r.index)
    for i in range(w, len(r)):
        rr = r.iloc[i-w:i]; mm = m.iloc[i-w:i]
        mask = mm < 0
        if mask.sum() >= 5:
            out.iloc[i] = rr[mask].cov(mm[mask])/mm[mask].var()
    return out
f2 = pd.DataFrame({a: roll_down_beta(rets[a], mkt) for a in assets})

# Factor 3: rate_beta_cn10y_60d: beta of each asset vs CN10Y returns (note CN10Y is yield series: price up = yield down)
cn = px['CN10Y'].pct_change()
def roll_beta(r, m, w=60):
    out = pd.Series(np.nan, index=r.index)
    for i in range(w, len(r)):
        rr = r.iloc[i-w:i]; mm = m.iloc[i-w:i]
        if rr.std() > 0 and mm.std() > 0:
            out.iloc[i] = rr.cov(mm)/mm.var()
    return out
f3 = pd.DataFrame({a: roll_beta(rets[a], cn) for a in assets})

# Recent rank IC over last 250 trading days (h=10 forward returns)
fwd = px.shift(-10)/px - 1
def rank_ic(fac, fwd_r, window=250):
    ics = []
    for t in fac.index[-window:]:
        f = fac.loc[t].dropna(); r = fwd_r.loc[t].dropna()
        common = f.index.intersection(r.index)
        if len(common) >= 8:
            ics.append(np.corrcoef(f[common].rank(), r[common].rank())[0,1])
    ics = np.array(ics)
    if len(ics)==0: return None
    return len(ics), ics.mean(), ics.mean()/ics.std()*np.sqrt(252), (ics>0).mean()

for name, f in [('vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60', f1), ('dn_mkt_beta_60d', f2), ('rate_beta_cn10y_60d', f3)]:
    res = rank_ic(f, fwd)
    print(f'{name}: n={res[0]} IC={res[1]:+.4f} ICIR={res[2]:+.3f} hit={res[3]:.3f}')
"

import pandas as pd, numpy as np

assets = ['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
data={}
for a in assets:
    df=pd.read_csv(f'../persistent/stock_data/{a}.csv')
    df.columns=[c.strip() for c in df.columns]
    df['date']=pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
    df=df.sort_values('date').set_index('date')
    data[a]=df['close']
px=pd.DataFrame(data)
px=px[px.index<='2033-07-22']
ret=px.pct_change()

mkt=ret.mean(axis=1)  # equal weight 15

# --- factor 1: vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60 ---
mom20=px/px.shift(20)-1
mom60=px/px.shift(60)-1
vol20=ret.rolling(20).std()
f1=(mom20-mom60)/vol20

# --- factor 2: dn_mkt_beta_60d (beta on down days only) ---
down = mkt.copy()
down[down>=0]=np.nan
f2=pd.DataFrame(index=px.index, columns=px.columns, dtype=float)
for a in assets:
    x=pd.concat([ret[a],down],axis=1).dropna()
    # rolling 60d beta via cov/var on down days
    cov=x[a].rolling(60).cov(x.iloc[:,1])
    var=x.iloc[:,1].rolling(60).var()
    f2[a]=cov/var

# --- factor 3: rate_beta_cn10y_60d ---
cny=px['CN10Y'].pct_change()
f3=pd.DataFrame(index=px.index, columns=px.columns, dtype=float)
for a in assets:
    x=pd.concat([ret[a],cny],axis=1).dropna()
    cov=x[a].rolling(60).cov(x.iloc[:,1])
    var=x.iloc[:,1].rolling(60).var()
    f3[a]=cov/var

# forward 10d return
fwd=px.shift(-10)/px-1

def ic_series(fv, fwd_ret, min_obs=8):
    idx=fv.index.intersection(fwd_ret.index)
    out={}
    for t in idx:
        x=fv.loc[t].dropna(); y=fwd_ret.loc[t].reindex(x.index).dropna()
        both=x.index.intersection(y.index)
        if len(both)>=min_obs:
            out[t]=np.corrcoef(x[both].rank(), y[both].rank())[0,1]
    return pd.Series(out)

factors={'vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60':(f1,1),'dn_mkt_beta_60d':(f2,1),'rate_beta_cn10y_60d':(f3,-1)}
for name,(fv,expdir) in factors.items():
    ic=ic_series(fv, fwd)
    ic=ic.sort_index()
    recent=ic[ic.index>='2032-01-01']
    for lab,win in [('60d',60),('120d',120),('252d',252),('full',len(ic))]:

    print(f'   latest value 2033-07-22 (ranked):')
    lv=fv.loc['2033-07-22'].dropna()

    print()

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, glob, os

files = sorted(glob.glob('../persistent/stock_data/*.csv'))
assets = [os.path.basename(f).replace('.csv','') for f in files]
print("assets:", assets)

data = {}
for f in files:
    df = pd.read_csv(f)
    df.columns = [c.strip().lower() for c in df.columns]
    dcol = 'date' if 'date' in df.columns else df.columns[0]
    df[dcol] = pd.to_datetime(df[dcol])
    df = df.sort_values(dcol).set_index(dcol)
    ccol = 'close' if 'close' in df.columns else 'adjclose' if 'adjclose' in df.columns else df.columns[1]
    data[os.path.basename(f).replace('.csv','')] = df[ccol].astype(float)

px = pd.DataFrame(data).dropna(how='all')
px = px.loc[px.index <= '2033-09-02']
ret = px.pct_change()

print("\n=== Last 3 rows (close) ===")
print(px.tail(3).T.round(2))

print("\n=== Returns (%) ===")
out = pd.DataFrame({
    'ret_5d': ret.tail(5).sum()*100,
    'ret_20d': ret.tail(20).sum()*100,
    'ret_60d': ret.tail(60).sum()*100,
    'ret_120d': ret.tail(120).sum()*100,
    'vol20_ann': ret.tail(20).std()*np.sqrt(252)*100,
    'dist_ma60': (px.iloc[-1]/px.tail(60).mean()-1)*100,
})
print(out.round(2))

print("\n=== EW market (15 assets) ===")
mkt = ret.mean(axis=1)
print("mkt ret 20d %:", round(mkt.tail(20).sum()*100,2))
print("mkt ret 60d %:", round(mkt.tail(60).sum()*100,2))
print("mkt vol20 ann %:", round(mkt.tail(20).std()*np.sqrt(252)*100,2))
print("mkt vol60 ann %:", round(mkt.tail(60).std()*np.sqrt(252)*100,2))

# cross-sectional dispersion of 20d returns
disp = ret.tail(20).sum().std()*100
print("cross-sectional dispersion of 20d rets (std across assets, %):", round(disp,2))

# avg pairwise correlation over last 60d
c = ret.tail(60).corr()
vals = c.values[np.triu_indices(len(c),1)]
print("avg pairwise corr 60d:", round(np.nanmean(vals),3))
EOF

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, os

assets = ['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
data = {}
for a in assets:
    p = f'../persistent/stock_data/{a}.csv'
    df = pd.read_csv(p)
    df.columns = [c.strip() for c in df.columns]
    date_col = 'date' if 'date' in df.columns else df.columns[0]
    df[date_col] = pd.to_datetime(df[date_col])
    df = df.sort_values(date_col).set_index(date_col)
    close_col = 'close' if 'close' in df.columns else 'Close'
    data[a] = df[close_col].astype(float)
px = pd.DataFrame(data)
print('px shape:', px.shape, 'last date:', px.index[-1].date())
px = px.dropna(how='all')
last = px.index[-1]
# use last 130 days for metrics
w = px.loc[px.index[-130]:]
rets = w.pct_change()
print()
print('=== Last close (', last.date(), ') ===')
print(px.iloc[-1].round(4).to_string())
print()
print('=== Returns (%): 5d/10d/20d/60d/120d ===')
r = pd.DataFrame({
  '5d': (px.iloc[-1]/px.iloc[-6]-1)*100,
  '10d': (px.iloc[-1]/px.iloc[-11]-1)*100,
  '20d': (px.iloc[-1]/px.iloc[-21]-1)*100,
  '60d': (px.iloc[-1]/px.iloc[-61]-1)*100,
  '120d': (px.iloc[-1]/px.iloc[-121]-1)*100,
})
print(r.round(2).to_string())
print()
print('=== Realized vol (ann %, 20d/60d) ===')
vol = pd.DataFrame({
  'vol20': rets.tail(20).std()*np.sqrt(252)*100,
  'vol60': rets.tail(60).std()*np.sqrt(252)*100,
})
print(vol.round(1).to_string())
"

    data[a] = df[close_col].astype(float)
px = pd.DataFrame(data)

px = px.loc[:'2033-09-16']
px = px.dropna(how='all')
print('px shape:', px.shape, 'last date:', px.index[-1].date())
last = px.index[-1]
rets = px.pct_change()
print()
print('=== Last close (', last.date(), ') ===')
print(px.iloc[-1].round(4).to_string())
print()
print('=== Returns (%): 5d/10d/20d/60d/120d ===')
r = pd.DataFrame({
  '5d': (px.iloc[-1]/px.iloc[-6]-1)*100,
  '10d': (px.iloc[-1]/px.iloc[-11]-1)*100,
  '20d': (px.iloc[-1]/px.iloc[-21]-1)*100,
  '60d': (px.iloc[-1]/px.iloc[-61]-1)*100,
  '120d': (px.iloc[-1]/px.iloc[-121]-1)*100,
})
print(r.round(2).to_string())
print()
print('=== Realized vol (ann %, 20d/60d) ===')
vol = pd.DataFrame({
  'vol20': rets.tail(20).std()*np.sqrt(252)*100,

})
print(vol.round(1).to_string())
print()
print('=== Trend: price vs MA20/MA60, dist from 252d high (%) ===')
w = px.tail(252)
ma20 = px.tail(20).mean()
ma60 = px.tail(60).mean()
hi252 = px.tail(252).max()
tr = pd.DataFrame({
  'px': px.iloc[-1],
  'ma20': ma20,
  'ma60': ma60,
  'above_ma20': px.iloc[-1] > ma20,
  'above_ma60': px.iloc[-1] > ma60,
  'off_252hi_pct': (px.iloc[-1]/hi252 - 1)*100,
})
print(tr.round(2).to_string())

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, glob, os

files = sorted(glob.glob('../persistent/stock_data/*.csv'))
cutoff = pd.Timestamp('2033-10-14')

prices = {}
for f in files:
    sym = os.path.basename(f).replace('.csv','')
    df = pd.read_csv(f)
    df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
    df = df[df['date'] <= cutoff]
    df = df.drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date')['close']
    prices[sym] = df

px = pd.DataFrame(prices).sort_index()
ret = px.pct_change()

# equal-weight market
mkt = ret.mean(axis=1)

def rank_ic(signal, fwd, dates):
    ics = []
    for d in dates:
        if d not in signal.index or d not in fwd.index: continue
        s = signal.loc[d].dropna()
        f = fwd.loc[d].reindex(s.index).dropna()
        common = s.index.intersection(f.index)
        if len(common) < 8: continue
        ic = s[common].rank().corr(f[common].rank())
        if np.isfinite(ic): ics.append(ic)
    return ics

# factor 1: vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60
mom20 = px/px.shift(20)-1
mom60 = px/px.shift(60)-1
vol20 = ret.rolling(20).std()
sig1 = (mom20 - mom60)/vol20

# factor 2: dn_mkt_beta_60d
down = mkt.where(mkt<0)
def roll_beta(y, x, w=60):
    return y.rolling(w).cov(x)/x.rolling(w).var()
sig2 = roll_beta(ret, down, 60)

# factor 3: rate_beta_cn10y_60d
cn10y = px['CN10Y'].pct_change()
sig3 = roll_beta(ret, cn10y, 60)

fwd = px.shift(-10)/px - 1  # forward 10d return

all_dates = px.index
recent1 = all_dates[all_dates >= '2032-10-01']  # last ~12m
recent2 = all_dates[all_dates >= '2033-04-01']  # last ~6m

for name, sig, exp_dir in [('vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60', sig1, 1),
                            ('dn_mkt_beta_60d', sig2, 1),
                            ('rate_beta_cn10y_60d', sig3, -1)]:
    for label, dd in [('12m', recent1), ('6m', recent2)]:
        ics = rank_ic(sig, fwd, dd)
        if len(ics)>5:
            ic = np.mean(ics); icir = np.mean(ics)/np.std(ics)*np.sqrt(len(ics))
            print(f"{name} [{label}]: n={len(ics)} IC={ic:+.4f} ICIR={icir:+.3f} hit={np.mean(np.sign(ics)==np.sign(np.mean(ics))):.2f}")
        else:
            print(f"{name} [{label}]: insufficient dates n={len(ics)}")

python - <<'EOF'
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, os

assets = ['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
base = '../persistent/stock_data'
px = {}
for a in assets:
    df = pd.read_csv(f'{base}/{a}.csv')
    df.columns = [c.strip() for c in df.columns]
    df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
    df = df.sort_values('date').set_index('date')
    px[a] = df['close']
P = pd.DataFrame(px).dropna(how='all')
P = P[P.index <= '2033-11-25']  # only through visible date
print('rows:', len(P), 'last date:', P.index[-1].date())

# equal-weight market
R = P.pct_change()
M = R.mean(axis=1)
# trend metrics
last = P.index[-1]
def stat(name, series, label):
    pass

print('\n=== Recent 10d and 60d asset returns (to', P.index[-1].date(), ') ===')
for a in assets:
    r10 = P[a].iloc[-1]/P[a].iloc[-11]-1 if len(P)>=11 else np.nan
    r60 = P[a].iloc[-1]/P[a].iloc[-61]-1 if len(P)>=61 else np.nan
    v20 = R[a].iloc[-20:].std()*np.sqrt(252) if len(R)>=20 else np.nan
    print(f'{a:10s} r10={r10*100:7.2f}%  r60={r60*100:7.2f}%  vol20={v20*100:5.1f}%')

print('\n=== Market (equal-weight 15) ===')
for n in [5,10,20,60]:
    if len(P)>=n+1:
        print(f'mkt {n}d ret: {M.iloc[-n:].sum()*100:6.2f}%')
mkt_vol20 = M.iloc[-20:].std()*np.sqrt(252)
mkt_vol60 = M.iloc[-60:].std()*np.sqrt(252)
print(f'mkt vol20={mkt_vol20*100:.1f}% vol60={mkt_vol60*100:.1f}%')
# MA slope
ma20 = M.rolling(20).mean(); ma60 = M.rolling(60).mean()
print('mkt MA20 last:', round(ma20.iloc[-1]*100,3), 'MA60 last:', round(ma60.iloc[-1]*100,3))
print('mkt MA20>MA60:', ma20.iloc[-1]>ma60.iloc[-1])
# drawdown from 60d high
peak = M.iloc[-60:].cummax()
dd = M.iloc[-60:]/peak - 1
print('mkt max DD 60d:', f'{dd.min()*100:.2f}%')

# correlation regime: avg pairwise corr of daily returns over last 60d
C = R.iloc[-60:].corr()
vals = C.values[np.triu_indices(len(C),1)]
print(f'avg pairwise corr 60d: {np.nanmean(vals):.3f}  median: {np.nanmedian(vals):.3f}')
# dispersion
disp = R.iloc[-20:].std(axis=1).mean()
print(f'cross-sectional dispersion (20d mean std): {disp*100:.2f}%')

# VIX & DXY
for f in ['VIX','DXY','USDJPY','EURUSD','USDCNY']:
    try:
        d = pd.read_csv(f'../persistent/index_data/{f}.csv')
        d.columns=[c.strip() for c in d.columns]
        d['date']=pd.to_datetime(d['date'])
        d=d.sort_values('date').set_index('date')
        d=d[d.index<=last]
        col = 'close' if 'close' in d.columns else d.columns[1]
        s = d[col].dropna()
        print(f'{f}: last={s.iloc[-1]:.2f} 20d ago={s.iloc[-21] if len(s)>20 else np.nan:.2f} 60d ago={s.iloc[-61] if len(s)>60 else np.nan:.2f}')
    except Exception as e:
        print(f, 'err', e)
EOF

"""Screener regime assessment - 2033-12-12 cycle. Uses ONLY data through visible_through 2033-12-09."""
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, glob, json

CUTOFF = "2033-12-09"
assets = ["000300.SH","000688.SH","SPX","HSI","N225","SX5E","SOX","NDX","XAU","COPPER","WTI","BTC","ETH","US10Y","CN10Y"]
macro = ["DXY","USDCNY","USDJPY","EURUSD","VIX"]

closes = {}
rets = {}
for a in assets:
    df = pd.read_csv(f"../persistent/stock_data/{a}.csv")
    df = df[df["date"] <= CUTOFF].reset_index(drop=True)
    closes[a] = pd.Series(df["close"].values, index=pd.to_datetime(df["date"]))
    rets[a] = closes[a].pct_change()

px = pd.DataFrame(closes)
r = pd.DataFrame(rets)

def ann_vol(s):
    return s.std() * np.sqrt(252)

print("="*100)
print("REGIME ASSESSMENT through", CUTOFF, " (last obs:", px.index.max().date(), ")")
print("="*100)
rows = []
for a in assets:
    c = px[a]
    rr = r[a]
    last = c.iloc[-1]
    ret21 = c.iloc[-1]/c.iloc[-22]-1 if len(c) > 22 else np.nan
    ret63 = c.iloc[-1]/c.iloc[-64]-1 if len(c) > 64 else np.nan
    ret126 = c.iloc[-1]/c.iloc[-127]-1 if len(c) > 127 else np.nan
    ret10 = c.iloc[-1]/c.iloc[-11]-1 if len(c) > 11 else np.nan
    vol21 = ann_vol(rr.iloc[-21:])
    vol63 = ann_vol(rr.iloc[-63:])
    # MA slope over last 21d: (MA20 today - MA20 21d ago)/MA20 21d ago
    ma20 = c.rolling(20).mean()
    ma60 = c.rolling(60).mean()
    ma20_slope = ma20.iloc[-1]/ma20.iloc[-22]-1 if len(ma20.dropna()) > 21 else np.nan
    # drawdown from 126d high
    dd = c.iloc[-1]/c.iloc[-126:].max()-1 if len(c) >= 126 else np.nan
    rows.append([a, round(ret10*100,1), round(ret21*100,1), round(ret63*100,1), round(ret126*100,1),
                 round(vol21*100,1), round(vol63*100,1), round(ma20_slope*100,1), round(dd*100,1)])
res = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["asset","r10d%","r21d%","r63d%","r126d%","vol21%","vol63%","ma20slope%","dd126%"])
print(res.to_string(index=False))

print()
print("="*100)
print("MACRO OBSERVATION-ONLY (through", CUTOFF, ")")
print("="*100)
for m in macro:
    df = pd.read_csv(f"../persistent/index_data/{m}.csv")
    df = df[df["date"] <= CUTOFF].reset_index(drop=True)
    c = pd.Series(df["close"].values, index=pd.to_datetime(df["date"]))
    rr = c.pct_change()
    ret21 = c.iloc[-1]/c.iloc[-22]-1 if len(c) > 22 else np.nan

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, glob

files = sorted(glob.glob('../persistent/stock_data/*.csv'))
names = [f.split('/')[-1].replace('.csv','') for f in files]

px = {}
rets = {}
for f,n in zip(files,names):
    d = pd.read_csv(f)
    d['date'] = pd.to_datetime(d['date'])
    d = d[d['date'] <= '2033-12-23'].sort_values('date').reset_index(drop=True)
    px[n] = d.set_index('date')['close']
    rets[n] = d.set_index('date')['pct_change']/100.0

px = pd.DataFrame(px)
rets = pd.DataFrame(rets)
print('dates:', px.index.min().date(), '->', px.index.max().date(), 'n=', len(px))

# Regime metrics as of last visible date
last = px.index[-1]
print('\n=== 20d and 60d returns to', last.date(), '===')
r20 = px.iloc[-1]/px.iloc[-21]-1
r60 = px.iloc[-1]/px.iloc[-61]-1
r120 = px.iloc[-1]/px.iloc[-121]-1
print(pd.DataFrame({'ret20d':r20,'ret60d':r60,'ret120d':r120}).round(4))

# Equal-weight market index
mkt = px.pct_change().mean(axis=1).dropna()
mktpx = (1+mkt).cumprod()
print('\n=== EW market ===')
print('20d ret:', round(mktpx.iloc[-1]/mktpx.iloc[-21]-1,4))
print('60d ret:', round(mktpx.iloc[-1]/mktpx.iloc[-61]-1,4))
print('120d ret:', round(mktpx.iloc[-1]/mktpx.iloc[-121]-1,4))
print('MA20 vs MA60:', round(mktpx.iloc[-20:].mean()/mktpx.iloc[-60:].mean()-1,4))
# trend slope: 60d linear slope of log price
import numpy.polynomial.polynomial as P
y = np.log(mktpx.iloc[-60:].values)
x = np.arange(len(y))
c = np.polyfit(x,y,1)
print('60d log-slope (per day):', round(c[0],5), '=> annualized', round(c[0]*252,3))

# Volatility
vol20 = rets.iloc[-20:].std()*np.sqrt(252)
vol60 = rets.iloc[-60:].std()*np.sqrt(252)
print('\n=== annualized vol (20d) ===')
print(vol20.sort_values(ascending=False).round(3))
print('EW mkt 20d vol:', round(mkt.iloc[-20:].std()*np.sqrt(252),3))

# Drawdown from 120d high
dd = px/px.rolling(120,min_periods=20).max()-1
print('\n=== 120d drawdown from high ===')
print(dd.iloc[-1].round(4))

# correlation regime: mean pairwise corr over last 60d
c60 = rets.iloc[-60:].corr()
vals = c60.values[np.triu_indices(15,1)]
print('\nmean pairwise corr 60d:', round(np.nanmean(vals),3), 'median:', round(np.nanmedian(vals),3))

# dispersion
disp = rets.iloc[-20:].std(axis=1).mean()
print('cross-sectional dispersion (20d avg daily):', round(disp*100,3),'%')

# recent 10d block return
print('\n=== last 10d block (approx 12-12..12-23) ===')
r10 = px.iloc[-1]/px.iloc[-9]-1
print(r10.round(4))
EOF

python << 'EOF'
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, glob

files = sorted(glob.glob('../persistent/stock_data/*.csv'))
names = [f.split('/')[-1].replace('.csv','') for f in files]
closes = {}
for f,n in zip(files,names):
    d = pd.read_csv(f)
    d['date'] = pd.to_datetime(d['date'])
    d = d[d['date'] <= '2033-12-23'].sort_values('date').reset_index(drop=True)
    closes[n] = d.set_index('date')['close'].astype(float)

assets = names
# staleness: 5 consecutive identical closes
def is_stale(c, n=5):
    tail = c.iloc[-n-1:]
    return bool((tail.diff().dropna().abs() < 1e-12).all())
stale = {a for a in assets if is_stale(closes[a])}
live = [a for a in assets if a not in stale]
print('stale:', sorted(stale))
print('live:', live)

usable = [closes[a].pct_change().rename(a) for a in live]
panel = pd.concat(usable, axis=1, join='inner').dropna().tail(130)
mkt = panel.mean(axis=1)
dn_x = mkt.clip(upper=0.0)

# factor values (mirror strategy)
def rolling_beta(y, x, win=60, min_obs=40):
    z = pd.concat([y.rename('y'), x.rename('x')], axis=1).dropna().tail(win)
    if len(z) < min_obs: return None
    var = float(z.x.var())
    if var <= 1e-14: return None
    return float(z.y.cov(z.x)/var)

def vol_adj_mom_accel(c, fast=20, slow=60, vol_win=20):
    r = c.pct_change()
    mom_fast = c/c.shift(fast)-1
    mom_slow = c/c.shift(slow)-1
    vol = r.rolling(vol_win).std()
    z = ((mom_fast-mom_slow)/vol).dropna()
    if len(z)<1: return None
    return float(z.iloc[-1])

cn10y_ret = closes['CN10Y'].pct_change()
print('\nCN10Y pct_change last 5 (recent):', cn10y_ret.dropna().tail(5).round(6).tolist())
print('CN10Y ret var (60d):', float(cn10y_ret.tail(60).var()) if cn10y_ret.tail(60).notna().any() else 'NA')

vals = {'vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60':{}, 'dn_mkt_beta_60d':{}, 'rate_beta_cn10y_60d':{}}
for a in live:
    vals['vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60'][a] = vol_adj_mom_accel(closes[a])
    vals['dn_mkt_beta_60d'][a] = rolling_beta(panel[a], dn_x)
    vals['rate_beta_cn10y_60d'][a] = rolling_beta(panel[a], cn10y_ret)

print('\n=== factor values (live names) ===')
for fid in vals:
    d = {k: round(v,3) if v is not None else None for k,v in vals[fid].items()}
    n_valid = sum(1 for v in d.values() if v is not None)
    print(fid, 'valid=', n_valid, '/', len(live))
    print('  ', d)

python << 'EOF'
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, glob

files = sorted(glob.glob('../persistent/stock_data/*.csv'))
names = [f.split('/')[-1].replace('.csv','') for f in files]
closes = {}
for f,n in zip(files,names):
    d = pd.read_csv(f); d['date'] = pd.to_datetime(d['date'])
    d = d[d['date'] <= '2033-12-23'].sort_values('date').reset_index(drop=True)
    closes[n] = d.set_index('date')['close'].astype(float)

assets = names
stale = {'000300.SH','BTC','CN10Y','ETH','HSI'}
live = [a for a in assets if a not in stale]

def rolling_beta_series(y, x, win=60, min_obs=40):
    z = pd.concat([y.rename('y'), x.rename('x')], axis=1).dropna()
    out = {}
    for i in range(len(z)):
        seg = z.iloc[max(0,i-win+1):i+1]
        if len(seg) < min_obs: continue
        var = float(seg.x.var())
        if var <= 1e-14: continue
        out[z.index[i]] = float(seg.y.cov(seg.x)/var)
    return pd.Series(out)

def mom_accel_series(c, fast=20, slow=60, vol_win=20):
    r = c.pct_change()
    z = ((c/c.shift(fast)-1) - (c/c.shift(slow)-1)) / r.rolling(vol_win).std()
    return z

# build panels
usable = [closes[a].pct_change().rename(a) for a in live]
panel = pd.concat(usable, axis=1, join='inner').dropna()
mkt = panel.mean(axis=1)
dn_x = mkt.clip(upper=0.0)

mom = pd.DataFrame({a: mom_accel_series(closes[a]) for a in live})
dnb = pd.DataFrame({a: rolling_beta_series(panel[a], dn_x) for a in live})

# 10d forward returns
fwd = panel.shift(-10)
# rank IC per date over last 250 valid dates
def rank_ic(fac, fwd, dts):
    ics = []
    for dt in dts:
        f = fac.loc[dt]; r = fwd.loc[dt]
        m = f.notna() & r.notna()
        if m.sum() < 6: continue
        ic = f[m].rank().corr(r[m].rank())
        if pd.notna(ic): ics.append(ic)
    return ics

dts = panel.index[-250:]
ics_mom = rank_ic(mom, fwd, dts)
ics_dnb = rank_ic(dnb, fwd, dts)

def stats(ics, label):
    if not ics: print(label, 'no data'); return
    a = np.array(ics)
    print(f'{label}: n={len(a)} mean_IC={a.mean():+.4f} ICIR={a.mean()/a.std():+.3f} hit={np.mean(a>0):.2f} last60={a[-60:].mean():+.4f} last120={a[-120:].mean():+.4f}')

stats(ics_mom, 'vol_adj_mom_accel (rank IC h=10)')
stats(ics_dnb, 'dn_mkt_beta        (rank IC h=10)')

# factor cross-correlation (rank, last values)
last = panel.index[-1]
f_mom = mom.loc[last]; f_dnb = dnb.loc[last]
m = f_mom.notna() & f_dnb.notna()
print('\nSpearman corr between the two factors (latest cross-section):', round(f_mom[m].rank().corr(f_dnb[m].rank()),3))
# over time
cors = []
for dt in panel.index[-250:]:
    a=mom.loc[dt]; b=dnb.loc[dt]
    mm = a.notna() & b.notna()
    if mm.sum()>=6:
        c = a[mm].rank().corr(b[mm].rank())
        if pd.notna(c): cors.append(c)
print('mean pairwise factor corr over 250d:', round(float(np.mean(cors)),3))
EOF

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, os
base='../persistent/stock_data/'
end=pd.Timestamp('2034-01-06')
syms=['000300.SH','000688.SH','BTC','CN10Y','COPPER','ETH','HSI','N225','NDX','SOX','SPX','SX5E','US10Y','WTI','XAU']
px={}
for s in syms:
    df=pd.read_csv(base+s+'.csv')
    df.columns=[c.strip().lower() for c in df.columns]
    df['date']=pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
    df=df[df['date']<=end].sort_values('date').reset_index(drop=True)
    px[s]=df.set_index('date')['close']
P=pd.DataFrame(px)
r=P.pct_change()

def is_stale(c,n=5):
    tail=c.dropna().iloc[-n-1:]
    return bool((tail.diff().dropna().abs()<1e-12).all())

stale={s:is_stale(P[s]) for s in syms}
print('stale flags:', {k:v for k,v in stale.items() if v})

# market = equal weight of 15
mkt=r.mean(axis=1)
# dn_mkt_beta_60d: beta(asset, min(mkt,0), 60)
print('\n=== dn_mkt_beta_60d (last value) ===')
dn=pd.DataFrame(index=P.index)
for s in syms:
    d=mkt.where(mkt<0)
    cov=r[s].rolling(60).cov(d)
    var=d.rolling(60).var()
    beta=(cov/var).iloc[-1]
    dn[s]=beta
print(dn.iloc[-1].round(3).to_string())

# vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60
print('\n=== vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60 ===')
va={}
for s in syms:
    c=P[s]
    mom_f=c/c.shift(20)-1; mom_s=c/c.shift(60)-1
    v=c.pct_change().rolling(20).std()
    z=(mom_f-mom_s)/v
    z=z.dropna()
    va[s]=float(z.iloc[-1]) if len(z)>0 and np.isfinite(z.iloc[-1]) else None
for s in syms: print(f"{s:10s} {va[s]:.3f}" if va[s] is not None else f"{s:10s} None")

# rate_beta_cn10y_60d: beta(asset, pct_change(CN10Y), 60)
print('\n=== rate_beta_cn10y_60d (last value) ===')
cn10=P['CN10Y'].pct_change()
rb={}
for s in syms:
    cov=r[s].rolling(60).cov(cn10); var=cn10.rolling(60).var()
    b=(cov/var).iloc[-1]
    rb[s]=b
print(pd.Series(rb).round(3).to_string())
EOF

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, os
assets = ['000300.SH','000688.SH','BTC','CN10Y','COPPER','ETH','HSI','N225','NDX','SOX','SPX','SX5E','US10Y','WTI','XAU']
data = {}
for a in assets:
    df = pd.read_csv(f'../persistent/stock_data/{a}.csv')
    df.columns = [c.strip() for c in df.columns]
    df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
    df = df.sort_values('date').set_index('date')
    data[a] = df['close']
px = pd.DataFrame(data)
px = px.loc[:'2034-01-20']
rets = px.pct_change()
print('Latest date in data:', px.index.max().date(), '| rows:', len(px))

# Recent returns
for d in [5, 10, 21, 63, 126, 252]:
    r = (px.iloc[-1]/px.iloc[-1-d]-1)*100 if len(px)>d else np.nan
    print(f'ret_{d}d%: ' + ' '.join(f'{a}:{r[a]:+.1f}' for a in assets))

# Trend regime: MA slopes
print('\n--- TREND (close vs 60d MA, 60d MA slope) ---')
for a in assets:
    c = px[a]
    ma20 = c.rolling(20).mean(); ma60 = c.rolling(60).mean()
    slope60 = (ma60.iloc[-1]/ma60.iloc[-21]-1)*100 if len(c)>80 else np.nan

# Vol regime
print('\n--- VOLATILITY (annualized, 21d & 60d) ---')
vol21 = rets.tail(21).std()*np.sqrt(252)*100
vol60 = rets.tail(60).std()*np.sqrt(252)*100
for a in assets:
    print(f'{a}: vol21={vol21[a]:.1f}% vol60={vol60[a]:.1f}%')

# Cross-asset correlation regime (avg pairwise corr of daily rets, last 60d)
c60 = rets.tail(60).corr()
vals = c60.values[np.triu_indices(len(assets), k=1)]
print(f'\nAvg pairwise corr (60d): {np.nanmean(vals):.3f} | median: {np.nanmedian(vals):.3f}')
c21 = rets.tail(21).corr()
vals21 = c21.values[np.triu_indices(len(assets), k=1)]
print(f'Avg pairwise corr (21d): {np.nanmean(vals21):.3f} | median: {np.nanmedian(vals21):.3f}')

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
assets = ['000300.SH','000688.SH','BTC','CN10Y','COPPER','ETH','HSI','N225','NDX','SOX','SPX','SX5E','US10Y','WTI','XAU']
px = pd.DataFrame({a: pd.read_csv(f'../persistent/stock_data/{a}.csv').set_index('date')['close'] for a in assets})
px.index = pd.to_datetime(px.index); px = px.sort_index().loc[:'2034-01-20']
rets = px.pct_change()

# Check staleness: how many of last 20 rows are zero-change for each asset
last = px.tail(20)
chg = last.pct_change().iloc[1:]
zero_frac = (chg.abs() < 1e-12).mean()
print('zero-change fraction last 20d per asset:')
print(zero_frac.sort_values())

# Factor 1: vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60
f1 = (px/px.shift(20)-1 - (px/px.shift(60)-1)) / rets.rolling(20).std()
# Factor 2: dn_mkt_beta_60d (beta on down-market days, equal-weight mkt)
mkt = rets.mean(axis=1)
dn = mkt.where(mkt<0)
def beta_down(a):
    x = dn.copy(); y = rets[a].copy()
    df = pd.concat([x,y],axis=1).dropna()
    df = df.tail(60)
    if len(df) < 40: return np.nan
    X = df.iloc[:,0].values; Y = df.iloc[:,1].values
    if np.nanstd(X) < 1e-12: return np.nan
    return np.polyfit(X, Y, 1)[0]
f2 = pd.Series({a: beta_down(a) for a in assets})
# Factor 3: rate_beta_cn10y_60d
cny = px['CN10Y'].pct_change()
def beta_rate(a):
    df = pd.concat([cny, rets[a]], axis=1).dropna().tail(60)
    if len(df) < 40: return np.nan
    X = df.iloc[:,0].values; Y = df.iloc[:,1].values
    if np.nanstd(X) < 1e-12: return np.nan
    return np.polyfit(X, Y, 1)[0]
f3 = pd.Series({a: beta_rate(a) for a in assets})

print('\n--- Factor 1: vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60 (recent) ---')
print(f1.tail(1).T.iloc[:,0].round(4))
print('\n--- Factor 2: dn_mkt_beta_60d (recent, low=safer) ---')
print(f2.round(4))
print('\n--- Factor 3: rate_beta_cn10y_60d (recent; CN10Y flat -> likely NaN) ---')
print(f3.round(4))
print('\nF3 valid count:', f3.notna().sum(), '| CN10Y pct_change last 60d nonzero days:', (cny.tail(60).abs()>1e-12).sum())
print('F2 valid count:', f2.notna().sum(), '| down-market days in last 60:', (dn.tail(60)<0).sum())
print('F1 valid count:', f1.tail(1).T.notna().sum().values[0])

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, glob, os

files = sorted(glob.glob('../persistent/stock_data/*.csv'))
data = {}
for f in files:
    name = os.path.basename(f)[:-4]
    df = pd.read_csv(f)
    df.columns = [c.strip() for c in df.columns]
    dcol = 'date' if 'date' in df.columns else df.columns[0]
    df[dcol] = pd.to_datetime(df[dcol])
    df = df.sort_values(dcol).set_index(dcol)
    ccol = 'close' if 'close' in df.columns else ('Close' if 'Close' in df.columns else df.columns[1])
    data[name] = df[ccol].astype(float)

px = pd.DataFrame(data)
print("shape:", px.shape, "range:", px.index.min().date(), "->", px.index.max().date())
print("\nlast close per asset:")
print(px.iloc[-1].round(2).to_string())

# returns
ret = px.pct_change()
print("\n=== Recent returns (through last visible date) ===")
for name in px.columns:
    s = px[name]
    r20 = s.iloc[-1]/s.iloc[-21]-1 if len(s)>21 else np.nan
    r60 = s.iloc[-1]/s.iloc[-61]-1 if len(s)>61 else np.nan
    r120 = s.iloc[-1]/s.iloc[-121]-1 if len(s)>121 else np.nan
    vol20 = ret[name].iloc[-20:].std()*np.sqrt(252) if len(ret)>20 else np.nan
    print(f"{name:>10s}  r20={r20:+.2%}  r60={r60:+.2%}  r120={r120:+.2%}  vol20_ann={vol20:.1%}")

# cross-asset breadth: fraction with positive 20d/60d return
pos20 = (px.iloc[-1]/px.iloc[-21]-1 > 0).mean()
pos60 = (px.iloc[-1]/px.iloc[-61]-1 > 0).mean()
print(f"\nbreadth: % assets positive 20d={pos20:.0%}, 60d={pos60:.0%}")

# average cross-correlation of daily returns (last 60d)
r60 = ret.iloc[-60:]
c = r60.corr()
vals = c.values[np.triu_indices(len(c),1)]
print(f"avg pairwise corr (60d): {np.nanmean(vals):.3f}")

# dispersion
disp = r60.mean(axis=1).std()  # cross-time dispersion of equal-weight index
cross_disp = r60.std(axis=1).mean()  # avg cross-sectional dispersion
print(f"equal-wt index 60d vol: {disp*np.sqrt(252):.1%}; avg cross-sectional std: {cross_disp:.2%}")

# VIX observation
vix = pd.read_csv('../persistent/index_data/VIX.csv')
print("\nVIX cols:", list(vix.columns))
vc = [c for c in vix.columns if 'close' in c.lower() or 'Close' in c][0]
vd = [c for c in vix.columns if 'date' in c.lower()][0]
vix[vd] = pd.to_datetime(vix[vd])
vix = vix.sort_values(vd)
print("VIX last 5:", vix[[vd,vc]].tail(5).to_string(index=False))
print("VIX 20d ago:", vix[[vd,vc]].iloc[-21].to_string())

python << 'EOF'
import pandas as pd, numpy as np

CUTOFF = '2034-03-03'
assets = ['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
macro = ['DXY','USDCNY','USDJPY','EURUSD','VIX']

def load(sym):
    df = pd.read_csv(f'../persistent/stock_data/{sym}.csv')
    df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
    df = df[df['date'] <= CUTOFF].reset_index(drop=True)
    return df

px = {}
for a in assets:
    px[a] = load(a)

# returns over horizons
print(f"{'asset':>10} {'close':>10} {'r5d%':>7} {'r10d%':>7} {'r21d%':>7} {'r63d%':>7} {'ma21>ma63':>8} {'vol21%':>7}")
for a in assets:
    c = px[a]['close']
    r5 = (c.iloc[-1]/c.iloc[-6]-1)*100 if len(c)>6 else np.nan
    r10 = (c.iloc[-1]/c.iloc[-11]-1)*100 if len(c)>11 else np.nan
    r21 = (c.iloc[-1]/c.iloc[-22]-1)*100 if len(c)>22 else np.nan
    r63 = (c.iloc[-1]/c.iloc[-64]-1)*100 if len(c)>64 else np.nan
    ma21 = c.rolling(21).mean().iloc[-1]
    ma63 = c.rolling(63).mean().iloc[-1]
    rets = c.pct_change().dropna()
    vol21 = rets.iloc[-21:].std()*np.sqrt(252)*100
    print(f"{a:>10} {c.iloc[-1]:>10.1f} {r5:>7.2f} {r10:>7.2f} {r21:>7.2f} {r63:>7.2f} {str(ma21>ma63):>8} {vol21:>7.1f}")

# macro
print()
for m in macro:
    df = pd.read_csv(f'../persistent/index_data/{m}.csv')
    df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
    df = df[df['date'] <= CUTOFF].reset_index(drop=True)
    c = df['close'] if 'close' in df.columns else df.iloc[:,1]
    r21 = (c.iloc[-1]/c.iloc[-22]-1)*100 if len(c)>22 else np.nan
    r63 = (c.iloc[-1]/c.iloc[-64]-1)*100 if len(c)>64 else np.nan
    print(f"{m:>10} last={c.iloc[-1]:>10.2f} r21d={r21:>7.2f}% r63d={r63:>7.2f}%")
EOF

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, json, glob, os

ASOF = "2034-03-20"
assets = ["000300.SH","000688.SH","SPX","NDX","SOX","HSI","N225","SX5E",
          "XAU","COPPER","WTI","BTC","ETH","US10Y","CN10Y"]
macro  = ["VIX","DXY","USDCNY","USDJPY","EURUSD"]

def load(p):
    df = pd.read_csv(p)
    df.columns = [c.strip().lower() for c in df.columns]
    df["date"] = pd.to_datetime(df["date"])
    df = df.sort_values("date").set_index("date")
    return df

px = {}
for a in assets:
    df = load(f"../persistent/stock_data/{a}.csv")
    df = df[df.index <= ASOF]
    px[a] = df["close"].astype(float)

mpx = {}
for m in macro:
    df = load(f"../persistent/index_data/{m}.csv")
    df = df[df.index <= ASOF]
    mpx[m] = df["close"].astype(float)

print("Last data date:", max(d.index.max() for d in px.values()).date())

PX = pd.DataFrame(px)
RET = PX.pct_change()

# --- market level (equal-weight cross-asset) ---
mkt = RET.mean(axis=1)
last = PX.index[-1]

def ret_over(df, n):
    return df.iloc[-1] / df.iloc[-1-n] - 1 if len(df) > n else np.nan

print("\n=== Cross-asset market (equal-weight of 15) ===")
print(f"Last date: {last.date()}")
for n,lab in [(5,"5d"),(10,"10d"),(21,"1m"),(63,"3m"),(126,"6m"),(252,"1y")]:
    if len(mkt) > n:
        print(f"  mkt {lab:>4}: {ret_over(mkt,n)*100:+.2f}%")

# trend: 20d vs 60d MA of mkt price
mkt_px = (1+mkt).cumprod()
ma20 = mkt_px.rolling(20).mean(); ma60 = mkt_px.rolling(60).mean()
print(f"  mkt px vs MA20: {'above' if mkt_px.iloc[-1]>ma20.iloc[-1] else 'below'} ({(mkt_px.iloc[-1]/ma20.iloc[-1]-1)*100:+.2f}%)")
print(f"  mkt px vs MA60: {'above' if mkt_px.iloc[-1]>ma60.iloc[-1] else 'below'} ({(mkt_px.iloc[-1]/ma60.iloc[-1]-1)*100:+.2f}%)")
print(f"  MA20 vs MA60:   {'bull' if ma20.iloc[-1]>ma60.iloc[-1] else 'bear'} slope")

# realized vol
rv20 = mkt.tail(20).std()*np.sqrt(252)
rv60 = mkt.tail(60).std()*np.sqrt(252)
print(f"  mkt realized vol 20d: {rv20*100:.1f}% ann | 60d: {rv60*100:.1f}% ann")

# drawdown from 252d high
peak = mkt_px.tail(252).max()
print(f"  mkt drawdown from 1y high: {(mkt_px.iloc[-1]/peak-1)*100:+.2f}%")

# consecutive direction days
signs = np.sign(mkt.tail(20))
run = 1
for i in range(len(signs)-2, -1, -1):
    if signs.iloc[i] == signs.iloc[-1]: run += 1
    else: break
print(f"  last {run} consecutive {'up' if signs.iloc[-1]>0 else 'down'} days")

print("\n=== Per-asset 10d/21d/63d returns (%) ===")
out = {}
for a in assets:
    s = PX[a]
    r = {lab: ret_over(s,n)*100 for n,lab in [(10,"r10"),(21,"r21"),(63,"r63")]}
    v = s.pct_change().tail(20).std()*np.sqrt(252)*100
    out[a] = {**r, "vol20": v}
    print(f"  {a:>9}: r10 {r['r10']:+7.2f}  r21 {r['r21']:+7.2f}  r63 {r['r63']:+8.2f}  vol20 {v:5.1f}%")

print("\n=== Macro (last values & 20d change) ===")
for m in macro:
    s = mpx[m]
    chg = (s.iloc[-1]/s.iloc[-21]-1)*100 if len(s)>21 else np.nan
    print(f"  {m:>7}: {s.iloc[-1]:.2f}  20d chg {chg:+.2f}%")

# correlation regime: avg pairwise 60d corr of daily returns
c60 = RET.tail(60).corr()
avg_corr = (c60.values[np.triu_indices_from(c60.values,1)]).mean()
c20 = RET.tail(20).corr()
avg_corr20 = (c20.values[np.triu_indices_from(c20.values,1)]).mean()
print(f"\nAvg pairwise corr (60d): {avg_corr:.2f} | (20d): {avg_corr20:.2f}")

# dispersion
disp = RET.tail(20).std(axis=1).mean()*100
print(f"Cross-sectional dispersion (20d, daily std of asset rets): {disp:.2f}%")

import pandas as pd, numpy as np

ASOF = "2034-03-20"
assets = ["000300.SH","000688.SH","SPX","NDX","SOX","HSI","N225","SX5E",
          "XAU","COPPER","WTI","BTC","ETH","US10Y","CN10Y"]

def load(p):
    df = pd.read_csv(p)
    df.columns = [c.strip().lower() for c in df.columns]
    df["date"] = pd.to_datetime(df["date"])
    df = df.sort_values("date").set_index("date")
    return df

px = {}
for a in assets:
    df = load(f"../persistent/stock_data/{a}.csv")
    df = df[df.index <= ASOF]
    px[a] = df["close"].astype(float)

PX = pd.DataFrame(px)
# check for dup dates / weird
print("rows per asset (last 12 dates shown):")
print(PX.tail(12))

RET = PX.pct_change()
print("\ndaily pct change last 8 rows (%), clipped view:")
print((RET.tail(8)*100).round(2).T)

mkt = RET.mean(axis=1)
print("\nmkt daily ret last 10 (%):")
print((mkt.tail(10)*100).round(3))

# look for extreme daily moves
ext = RET[(RET.abs() > 0.5)].stack()
print("\nextreme daily moves >50% (last 20):")
print(ext.tail(20) if len(ext) else "none")

# check frozen assets: last 5 rows
print("\nFrozen check (unique close values in last 60d):")
for a in assets:
    s = PX[a].tail(60)
    print(f"  {a:>9}: n_unique={s.nunique():3d}  last={s.iloc[-1]:.4f}")

# correlation among liquid assets only
liquid = [a for a in assets if PX[a].tail(60).nunique() > 30]
print("\nliquid assets:", liquid)
RETl = RET[liquid]
c60 = RETl.tail(60).corr()
c20 = RETl.tail(20).corr()
v60 = c60.values[np.triu_indices_from(c60.values,1)]
v20 = c20.values[np.triu_indices_from(c20.values,1)]
print(f"avg pairwise corr 60d (liquid): {np.nanmean(v60):.2f} | 20d: {np.nanmean(v20):.2f}")
print(f"corr range 20d: {np.nanmin(v20):.2f}..{np.nanmax(v20):.2f}")

import pandas as pd, numpy as np

ASOF = "2034-03-20"
assets = ["000300.SH","000688.SH","SPX","NDX","SOX","HSI","N225","SX5E",
          "XAU","COPPER","WTI","BTC","ETH","US10Y","CN10Y"]

def load(p):
    df = pd.read_csv(p)
    df.columns = [c.strip().lower() for c in df.columns]
    df["date"] = pd.to_datetime(df["date"])
    df = df.sort_values("date").set_index("date")
    return df

px = {}
for a in assets:
    df = load(f"../persistent/stock_data/{a}.csv")
    df = df[df.index <= ASOF]
    px[a] = df["close"].astype(float)
PX = pd.DataFrame(px)
RET = PX.pct_change()

frozen = [a for a in assets if PX[a].tail(60).nunique() <= 2]
liquid = [a for a in assets if a not in frozen]
print("frozen:", frozen, "| liquid:", liquid)

# ---- factor computations (on full 15 then mask) ----
# 1) vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60 = (mom20 - mom60)/vol20
mom20 = PX / PX.shift(20) - 1
mom60 = PX / PX.shift(60) - 1
vol20 = RET.rolling(20).std()
f_mom = (mom20 - mom60) / vol20

# 2) dn_mkt_beta_60d: beta on down-market days
mkt = RET.mean(axis=1)
down = mkt.where(mkt < 0)
f_beta = pd.DataFrame(index=RET.index, columns=PX.columns, dtype=float)
for a in assets:
    x = down; y = RET[a]
    df = pd.concat([x, y], axis=1).dropna()
    if len(df) < 40: continue
    # rolling 60d beta of y on x (down days only)
    betas = []
    idx = df.index
    for i in range(len(df)):
        w = df.iloc[max(0,i-59):i+1]
        if len(w) >= 40 and w.iloc[:,0].std() > 0:
            b = np.cov(w.iloc[:,0], w.iloc[:,1])[0,1] / w.iloc[:,0].var()
            betas.append((idx[i], b))
        else:
            betas.append((idx[i], np.nan))
    f_beta[a] = pd.Series(dict(betas)).reindex(RET.index)

# 3) rate_beta_cn10y_60d: beta on CN10Y pct change
cn = PX["CN10Y"].pct_change()
f_rate = pd.DataFrame(index=RET.index, columns=PX.columns, dtype=float)
for a in assets:
    x = cn; y = RET[a]
    df = pd.concat([x, y], axis=1).dropna()
    if len(df) < 40: continue
    betas = []
    idx = df.index
    for i in range(len(df)):
        w = df.iloc[max(0,i-59):i+1]
        if len(w) >= 40 and w.iloc[:,0].std() > 0:
            b = np.cov(w.iloc[:,0], w.iloc[:,1])[0,1] / w.iloc[:,0].var()
            betas.append((idx[i], b))
        else:
            betas.append((idx[i], np.nan))
    f_rate[a] = pd.Series(dict(betas)).reindex(RET.index)

# ---- rolling 10d-forward rank IC over last 120 trading days ----
fwd = RET.shift(-10)  # 10d forward return (t -> t+10)
fwd10 = (PX.shift(-10)/PX - 1)

def ic_series(factor, fwd10, n_min=8):
    out = {}
    for d in factor.index:
        x = factor.loc[d]; y = fwd10.loc[d]
        m = x.notna() & y.notna()
        if m.sum() >= n_min:
            out[d] = np.corrcoef(x[m].rank(), y[m].rank())[0,1]
    return pd.Series(out)

print("\n=== Rolling 10d-forward rank IC, last 120 trading days ===")
for name, f in [("vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60", f_mom), ("dn_mkt_beta_60d", f_beta), ("rate_beta_cn10y_60d", f_rate)]:
    s = ic_series(f, fwd10)
    s = s[s.index >= s.index[-1] - pd.Timedelta(days=200)]
    print(f"{name:>24}: n={len(s):3d}  mean_ic={s.mean():+.4f}  icir={s.mean()/s.std():+.3f}  hit={ (s>0).mean():.2f}  last10d_ic={s.tail(10).mean():+.4f}")

# also current factor values
print("\n=== Current factor values (2034-03-20) ===")
for name, f, sign in [("mom_accel", f_mom, 1), ("dn_beta", f_beta, 1), ("rate_beta", f_rate, -1)]:
    print(f"-- {name} (dir {sign}) --")
    row = f.loc[ASOF].dropna().sort_values()
    print(row.round(3).to_string())

# recent 10d returns for comparison
print("\n-- 10d returns (2034-03-20) --")
print((fwd10.loc[ASOF]*100).sort_values().round(2).to_string())

import pandas as pd, numpy as np

ASOF = "2034-03-20"
assets = ["000300.SH","000688.SH","SPX","NDX","SOX","HSI","N225","SX5E",
          "XAU","COPPER","WTI","BTC","ETH","US10Y","CN10Y"]

def load(p):
    df = pd.read_csv(p)
    df.columns = [c.strip().lower() for c in df.columns]
    df["date"] = pd.to_datetime(df["date"])
    df = df.sort_values("date").set_index("date")
    return df

px = {}
for a in assets:
    df = load(f"../persistent/stock_data/{a}.csv")
    df = df[df.index <= ASOF]
    px[a] = df["close"].astype(float)
PX = pd.DataFrame(px)
RET = PX.pct_change()

liquid = [a for a in assets if PX[a].tail(60).nunique() > 2]
mkt_ew = (1+RET[liquid].mean(axis=1)).cumprod()   # equal-weight among liquid only
print("Equal-weight market (10 liquid assets, excluding frozen):")
for n,lab in [(5,"5d"),(10,"10d"),(21,"1m"),(63,"3m")]:
    if len(mkt_ew) > n:
        print(f"  {lab:>3}: {(mkt_ew.iloc[-1]/mkt_ew.iloc[-1-n]-1)*100:+.2f}%")
ma20 = mkt_ew.rolling(20).mean(); ma60 = mkt_ew.rolling(60).mean()
print(f"  price vs MA20: {(mkt_ew.iloc[-1]/ma20.iloc[-1]-1)*100:+.2f}% | vs MA60: {(mkt_ew.iloc[-1]/ma60.iloc[-1]-1)*100:+.2f}% | MA20>MA60: {ma20.iloc[-1]>ma60.iloc[-1]}")
rv20 = RET[liquid].mean(axis=1).tail(20).std()*np.sqrt(252)
rv60 = RET[liquid].mean(axis=1).tail(60).std()*np.sqrt(252)
print(f"  realized vol 20d: {rv20*100:.1f}% | 60d: {rv60*100:.1f}%")
dd = mkt_ew.iloc[-1]/mkt_ew.tail(252).max()-1
print(f"  drawdown from 1y high: {dd*100:+.2f}%")
# 10d and 21d returns of liquid names
r10 = (PX.iloc[-1]/PX.iloc[-11]-1)*100
r21 = (PX.iloc[-1]/PX.iloc[-22]-1)*100
r63 = (PX.iloc[-1]/PX.iloc[-64]-1)*100
tbl = pd.DataFrame({"r10":r10,"r21":r21,"r63":r63}).round(2)
print("\n", tbl.to_string())
print("\nEqual-weight mkt r21 (all 15 incl frozen at 0):", round(((1+RET.mean(axis=1)).tail(21).prod()-1)*100,2), "%")

corr20 = last20.corr()
print("avg pairwise corr 20d:", round(corr20.values[np.triu_indices(len(corr20),1)].mean(),3))

# Dispersion

import pandas as pd, numpy as np

cut = "2034-04-28"
assets = ["000300.SH","000688.SH","BTC","CN10Y","COPPER","ETH","HSI","N225","NDX","SOX","SPX","SX5E","US10Y","WTI","XAU"]

    df = pd.read_csv(f"../persistent/stock_data/{a}.csv")
    df.columns=[c.strip() for c in df.columns]
    df['date']=df['date'].astype(str)
    df=df[df['date']<=cut].reset_index(drop=True)
    px[a]=df.set_index('date')['close']
closes = pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index()
rets = closes.pct_change()
rets = rets.replace([np.inf,-np.inf], np.nan)

# ---- factor 1: vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60 ----
mom20 = closes/closes.shift(20)-1
mom60 = closes/closes.shift(60)-1
vol20 = rets.rolling(20).std()
f1 = (mom20-mom60)/vol20
last1 = f1.iloc[-1]
# rank spread
r1 = last1.rank()
print("=== vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60 last cross-section ===")
print(pd.DataFrame({"signal":last1.round(3),"rank":r1.round(2)}).sort_values("signal",ascending=False).to_string())

# ---- factor 2: dn_mkt_beta_60d ----
mkt = rets.mean(axis=1)  # EW of 15 (includes flat names -> diluted but live)
down = mkt.where(mkt<0, 0.0)
# rolling beta of asset on down-market days
def roll_beta(y, x, w=60, minobs=40):
    out = pd.Series(np.nan, index=y.index)
    for i in range(w-1, len(y)):
        yy=y.iloc[i-w+1:i+1]; xx=x.iloc[i-w+1:i+1]
        m = yy.notna() & xx.notna()
        if m.sum()<minobs: continue
        if xx[m].std()==0: continue
        out.iloc[i] = np.cov(yy[m],xx[m])[0,1]/np.var(xx[m])
    return out
f2 = pd.DataFrame({a: roll_beta(rets[a], down) for a in assets})
last2 = f2.iloc[-1]
r2 = last2.rank()
print("\n=== dn_mkt_beta_60d last cross-section (lower = safer) ===")
print(pd.DataFrame({"signal":last2.round(3),"rank":r2.round(2)}).sort_values("signal",ascending=False).to_string())

# ---- factor 3: rate_beta_cn10y_60d ----
cn = closes["CN10Y"].pct_change()
f3 = pd.DataFrame({a: roll_beta(rets[a], cn) for a in assets})
last3 = f3.iloc[-1]
print("\n=== rate_beta_cn10y_60d last cross-section ===")

# correlations among live factor signals (only live names)

print()
print('=== Dispersion of 20d returns ===')

print('avg cross-sectional std (20d):', round(disp,3))
"

import json, base64, zlib, io
import pandas as pd, numpy as np

def load_panel(fid):
    with open(f'factors/{fid}.json') as f:
        obj = json.load(f)
    art = obj['validation']['signal_artifact']
    fmt = art['format']
    cols = art['columns']
    if fmt == 'base64:zlib:csv':
        raw = base64.b64decode(art['data'])
        csv = zlib.decompress(raw).decode()
        df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(csv))
        if 'date' in df.columns:
            df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
            df = df.set_index('date')
        return df[cols]
    elif fmt == 'panel_json_v1':
        dates = pd.to_datetime(art['dates'])
        data = np.array(art['data']) if isinstance(art['data'], list) else art['data']
        df = pd.DataFrame(data, index=dates, columns=cols)
        return df
    return None

cut = pd.Timestamp('2034-06-09')
for fid in ['vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60','dn_mkt_beta_60d','rate_beta_cn10y_60d']:
    try:
        sig = load_panel(fid)
        print(fid, 'shape', sig.shape, 'date range', sig.index.min().date(), sig.index.max().date())
        # recent availability
        recent = sig[sig.index <= cut]
        print('  last date:', recent.index.max().date() if len(recent) else 'NONE')
    except Exception as e:
        print(fid, 'ERROR', repr(e)[:200])

import json, zlib, base64, pandas as pd, numpy as np, io

def load_signal(fid):
    d = json.load(open(f'factors/{fid}.json'))
    art = d['validation']['signal_artifact']
    fmt = art['format']
    if fmt == 'base64:zlib:csv':
        raw = zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(art['data']))
        df = pd.read_csv(io.BytesIO(raw), index_col=0, parse_dates=True)
    elif fmt == 'panel_json_v1':
        df = pd.DataFrame(art['data'], index=pd.to_datetime(art['dates']), columns=art['columns'])
    else:
        raise ValueError(fmt)
    return df, d

assets = ['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
base='../persistent/stock_data'
px={}
for a in assets:
    df = pd.read_csv(f'{base}/{a}.csv'); df.columns=[c.strip() for c in df.columns]
    df['date']=pd.to_datetime(df['date']); df=df.sort_values('date').set_index('date')
    px[a]=df['close']
P=pd.DataFrame(px); P=P[~P.index.duplicated(keep='last')].sort_index()
P=P[P.index<='2034-07-21']

for fid in ['vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60','dn_mkt_beta_60d','rate_beta_cn10y_60d']:
    S, d = load_signal(fid)
    S = S[S.index<='2034-07-21']
    print('='*70)
    print(fid, 'signal rows:', len(S), S.index.min().date(), '->', S.index.max().date())
    # align with price panel
    common = S.index.intersection(P.index)
    Sc = S.loc[common].replace([np.inf,-np.inf], np.nan)
    Pc = P.loc[common]
    # forward 10d return
    fwd = Pc.shift(-10)/Pc - 1
    ics=[]
    for i in range(len(common)):
        s = Sc.iloc[i]; f = fwd.iloc[i]
        m = s.notna() & f.notna()
        if m.sum() >= 8:
            ics.append((common[i], s[m].rank().corr(f[m].rank())))
    ic = pd.DataFrame(ics, columns=['date','ic']).set_index('date')
    ic = ic[ic.index>='2034-01-01']
    print(f'  IC h=10 since 2034-01-01: n={len(ic)} mean={ic["ic"].mean():+.4f} icir={ic["ic"].mean()/ic["ic"].std():+.3f} hit={(ic["ic"]>0).mean():.2f}')
    ic60 = ic[ic.index>='2034-05-01']
    if len(ic60)>3:
        print(f'  IC h=10 since 2034-05-01: n={len(ic60)} mean={ic60["ic"].mean():+.4f} hit={(ic60["ic"]>0).mean():.2f}')
    # current signal (last row)
    last = Sc.iloc[-1]
    print('  last signal date:', common[-1].date())
    print('  current signal (rank 0..1):')
    rk = last.rank(pct=True)
    print('   ', rk.sort_values(ascending=False).round(2).to_dict())

python << 'EOF'
import json, zlib, base64, pandas as pd, numpy as np, io

def load_signal(fid):
    d = json.load(open(f'factors/{fid}.json'))
    art = d['validation']['signal_artifact']
    fmt = art['format']
    if fmt == 'base64:zlib:csv':
        raw = zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(art['data']))
        df = pd.read_csv(io.BytesIO(raw), index_col=0, parse_dates=True)
    elif fmt == 'panel_json_v1':
        dates = pd.to_datetime(art['dates'])
        cols = art['assets']
        vals = art['values']
        df = pd.DataFrame(vals, index=dates, columns=cols)
    else:
        raise ValueError(fmt)
    return df, d

assets = ['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
base='../persistent/stock_data'
px={}
for a in assets:
    df = pd.read_csv(f'{base}/{a}.csv'); df.columns=[c.strip() for c in df.columns]
    df['date']=pd.to_datetime(df['date']); df=df.sort_values('date').set_index('date')
    px[a]=df['close']
P=pd.DataFrame(px); P=P[~P.index.duplicated(keep='last')].sort_index()
P=P[P.index<='2034-07-21']

for fid in ['vol_adj_mom_accel_20x60','dn_mkt_beta_60d','rate_beta_cn10y_60d']:
    S, d = load_signal(fid)
    S = S[S.index<='2034-07-21']
    print('='*70)
    print(fid, 'signal rows:', len(S), S.index.min().date(), '->', S.index.max().date())
    common = S.index.intersection(P.index)
    Sc = S.loc[common].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors='coerce').replace([np.inf,-np.inf], np.nan)
    Pc = P.loc[common]
    fwd = Pc.shift(-10)/Pc - 1
    ics=[]
    for i in range(len(common)):
        s = Sc.iloc[i]; f = fwd.iloc[i]
        m = s.notna() & f.notna()
        if m.sum() >= 8:
            ics.append((common[i], s[m].rank().corr(f[m].rank())))
    ic = pd.DataFrame(ics, columns=['date','ic']).set_index('date')
    ic_recent = ic[ic.index>='2034-01-01']
    print(f'  IC h=10 since 2034-01-01: n={len(ic_recent)} mean={ic_recent["ic"].mean():+.4f} icir={ic_recent["ic"].mean()/ic_recent["ic"].std():+.3f} hit={(ic_recent["ic"]>0).mean():.2f}')
    ic60 = ic[ic.index>='2034-05-01']
    if len(ic60)>3:
        print(f'  IC h=10 since 2034-05-01: n={len(ic60)} mean={ic60["ic"].mean():+.4f} hit={(ic60["ic"]>0).mean():.2f}')
    last = Sc.iloc[-1]
    print('  last signal date:', common[-1].date())
    rk = last.rank(pct=True)
    print('  current signal rank (0..1):')
    print('   ', rk.sort_values(ascending=False).round(2).to_dict())
EOF

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
